src.control_plane

Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.

Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing, specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans, evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries, and closed-loop governed task orchestration.

  1"""
  2Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.
  3
  4Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing,
  5specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans,
  6evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries,
  7and closed-loop governed task orchestration.
  8"""

@dataclass
class TaskSpec(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
129@dataclass
130class TaskSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    repository: str
135    objective: str
136    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
137    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
138    task_class: str = "feature"
139    risk_level: str = "medium"
140    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
141    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
142    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
143    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
144    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
145    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
146    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
147    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
148    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
149    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
150    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
151    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
152    current_state: str = "discovered"
153    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
154    # Exact repo-relative paths this task may commit (#59.2 Phase 8). Empty
155    # (the default) means unrestricted -- existing serialized task.yaml files
156    # without this key deserialize unaffected. When non-empty,
157    # GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit fails closed on any other path.
158    allowed_paths: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
159    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
160    schema: str = TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
161
162    def __post_init__(self):
163        self.validate()
164
165    def validate(self) -> None:
166        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
167        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
168            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
169        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
170            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
171        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
172            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
173        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
174            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
175                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
176            )
177        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
178            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
179                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
180            )
181        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
182            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
183                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
184            )
185        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
186            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
187                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
188            )
189        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
190            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
191                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
192            )
193
194    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
195        """
196        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
197        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
198        """
199        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
200            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
201
202        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
203        if new_state not in allowed:
204            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
205                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
206                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
207            )
208
209        self.current_state = new_state
210        if "history" not in self.metadata:
211            self.metadata["history"] = []
212        self.metadata["history"].append(
213            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
214        )
215
216    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
217        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
218        return asdict(self)
219
220    @classmethod
221    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
222        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
223        d = dict(data)
224        d.pop("schema", None)
225        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
226        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
227        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
228
229    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
230        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
231        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
232
233    @classmethod
234    def from_json(cls, json_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
235        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
236        data = json.loads(json_str)
237        return cls.from_dict(data)

267    def get_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:

271    def get_resource(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:
272        """Retrieves a resource profile without conflating it with provider ID."""
273        return self._resources.get(resource_id)
274
275    def list_resources(self) -> List[AgentProfile]:
276        """Lists registered resource profiles in deterministic registration order."""
277        return list(self._resources.values())
278
279    def list_agents(self, only_available: bool = False) -> List[AgentProfile]:
280        """Lists all registered agent profiles."""
281        agents = list(self._agents.values())
282        if only_available:
283            agents = [a for a in agents if a.availability == "available"]
284        return agents
285
286    def filter_agents(
287        self,
288        capability: Optional[str] = None,
289        reasoning_tier: Optional[str] = None,
290        cost_class: Optional[str] = None,
291        interface: Optional[str] = None,
292        only_available: bool = True,
293    ) -> List[AgentProfile]:
294        """Filters agents matching multiple criteria."""
295        results = self.list_agents(only_available=only_available)
296        if capability:
297            results = [a for a in results if capability in a.capabilities]
298        if reasoning_tier:
299            results = [a for a in results if a.reasoning_tier == reasoning_tier]
300        if cost_class:
301            results = [a for a in results if a.cost_class == cost_class]
302        if interface:
303            results = [a for a in results if a.interface == interface]
304        return results

853        agent_id: str = "fake_agent",
854        default_exit_code: int = 0,
855        default_stdout: str = "Fake implementation completed successfully. No issues found.",
856        default_stderr: str = "",

866        self.side_effect = side_effect
867        self.duration = duration
868        self.default_timed_out = default_timed_out
869        self.default_metadata = dict(default_metadata or {})

871

873        return True
874
875    def probe_readiness(self) -> BackendReadiness:
876        return BackendReadiness(

878            installed=True,
879            reachable=True,
880            authentication=AuthenticationStatus.UNKNOWN,
881            evidence="deterministic_fake_backend",
882        )

884    def execute(
885        self,
886        task: TaskSpec,
887        cwd: Union[str, Path],
888        role: str = "implementation",
889        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
890        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
891        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
892        **kwargs,
893    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
894        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
895        prompt = prompt_override or f"Fake execute: {task.objective}"
896        self.executed_calls.append({
897            "task_id": task.task_id if task else "unknown",
898            "role": role,
899            "prompt": prompt,
900            "cwd": str(target_cwd),
901        })
902
903        if self.side_effect:
904            try:
905                self.side_effect(task, target_cwd, prompt)
906            except Exception as exc:
907                return AgentExecutionResult(
908                    agent_id=self.agent_id,
909                    role=role,
910                    command=f"fake_agent({self.agent_id})",
911                    exit_code=1,
912                    stdout="",
913                    stderr=f"Side effect error: {exc}",
914                    duration_seconds=self.duration,
915                    success=False,
916                    error_message=str(exc),
917                )
918
919        ok = (self.default_exit_code == 0)
920        return AgentExecutionResult(
921            agent_id=self.agent_id,
922            role=role,
923            command=f"fake_agent({self.agent_id})",
924            exit_code=self.default_exit_code,
925            stdout=self.default_stdout,
926            stderr=self.default_stderr,
927            duration_seconds=self.duration,
928            success=ok,
929            timed_out=self.default_timed_out,
930            error_message=None if ok else f"Exit code {self.default_exit_code}",
931            metadata=dict(self.default_metadata),
932        )

class SubprocessAgentBackend(src.control_plane.AgentBackend): 
299class SubprocessAgentBackend(AgentBackend):
300    """Base backend for executing CLI agents via deterministic subprocess execution."""
301
302    def __init__(
303        self,
304        agent_id: str,
305        binary_name: str,
306        cmd_builder: Optional[Callable[[TaskSpec, Path, str, str], List[str]]] = None,
307    ):
308        self.agent_id = agent_id
309        self.binary_name = binary_name
310        self._builder = cmd_builder
311
312    def is_available(self) -> bool:
313        return shutil.which(self.binary_name) is not None
314
315    def probe_readiness(self) -> BackendReadiness:
316        """Reports executable presence without contacting the hosted provider."""
317        installed = self.is_available()
318        native_support = self.agent_id in {"codex", "agy", "devin_cli"}
319        return BackendReadiness(
320            status=(
321                ReadinessStatus.READY
322                if installed
323                else ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
324            ),
325            installed=installed,
326            reachable=None,
327            authentication=AuthenticationStatus.UNKNOWN,
328            reason=None if installed else "MISSING_EXECUTABLE",
329            evidence=f"executable:{self.binary_name}",
330            unattended_mutation_capable=installed if native_support else (False if installed and self.agent_id == "gemini_cli" else None),
331            capability_reason="native_role_support" if native_support and installed else (
332                "headless non-interactive mutation unsupported" if self.agent_id == "gemini_cli" and installed else (
333                    "MISSING_EXECUTABLE" if not installed else None
334                )
335            ),
336        )
337
338    def build_command(self, task: TaskSpec, cwd: Path, role: str, prompt: str) -> List[str]:
339        if self._builder:
340            return self._builder(task, cwd, role, prompt)
341        return [self.binary_name, prompt]
342
343    def execute(
344        self,
345        task: TaskSpec,
346        cwd: Union[str, Path],
347        role: str = "implementation",
348        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
349        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
350        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
351        **kwargs,
352    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
353        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
354        if not self.is_available():
355            return AgentExecutionResult(
356                agent_id=self.agent_id,
357                role=role,
358                command=self.binary_name,
359                exit_code=127,
360                stdout="",
361                stderr=f"Agent binary '{self.binary_name}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
362                duration_seconds=0.0,
363                success=False,
364                error_message=f"Agent '{self.agent_id}' unavailable",
365                metadata={LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY: LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED},
366            )
367
368        prompt = prompt_override or f"Execute task {task.task_id}: {task.objective}"
369        cmd_args = self.build_command(task, target_cwd, role, prompt)
370        cmd_str = " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
371
372        env = os.environ.copy()
373        if env_vars:
374            env.update(env_vars)
375
376        start_t = time.time()
377        try:
378            completed = subprocess.run(
379                args=cmd_args,
380                cwd=str(target_cwd),
381                capture_output=True,
382                text=True,
383                env=env,
384                timeout=timeout_seconds,
385            )
386            elapsed = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
387            is_timeout = False
388            combined_err = f"{completed.stderr}\n{completed.stdout}".lower()
389            timeout_markers = (
390                "error: timeout waiting for response",
391                "timeout waiting for response",
392                "timed out",
393                "request timed out",
394                "connection timed out",
395                "gateway timeout",
396                "operation timed out",
397                "deadline exceeded",
398                "timeout after",
399            )
400            if any(marker in combined_err for marker in timeout_markers):
401                is_timeout = True
402
403            err_msg = None
404            if completed.returncode != 0:
405                if is_timeout and completed.stderr and completed.stderr.strip():
406                    err_msg = completed.stderr.strip()
407                elif is_timeout:
408                    err_msg = "Error: timeout waiting for response"
409                else:
410                    err_msg = f"Process exited with code {completed.returncode}"
411
412            return AgentExecutionResult(
413                agent_id=self.agent_id,
414                role=role,
415                command=cmd_str,
416                exit_code=completed.returncode,
417                stdout=completed.stdout,
418                stderr=completed.stderr,
419                duration_seconds=elapsed,
420                success=(completed.returncode == 0),
421                timed_out=is_timeout,
422                error_message=err_msg,
423                metadata=_launch_metadata(
424                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED,
425                    TIMEOUT_SOURCE_TRANSCRIPT if is_timeout else None,
426                ),
427            )
428        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
429            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
430            out = exc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stdout else ""
431            err = exc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stderr else ""
432            return AgentExecutionResult(
433                agent_id=self.agent_id,
434                role=role,
435                command=cmd_str,
436                exit_code=-1,
437                stdout=out,
438                stderr=err + f"\nTimeout after {timeout_seconds}s.",
439                duration_seconds=dur,
440                success=False,
441                timed_out=True,
442                error_message=f"Timeout after {timeout_seconds}s",
443                metadata=_launch_metadata(
444                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS
445                ),
446            )
447        except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError, PermissionError) as exc:
448            # The OS refused the spawn, so the executable really is missing or
449            # unusable. This is the only in-flight error that means that.
450            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
451            return AgentExecutionResult(
452                agent_id=self.agent_id,
453                role=role,
454                command=cmd_str,
455                exit_code=127,
456                stdout="",
457                stderr=str(exc),
458                duration_seconds=dur,
459                success=False,
460                error_message=str(exc),
461                metadata={LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY: LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED},
462            )
463        except Exception as exc:
464            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
465            return AgentExecutionResult(
466                agent_id=self.agent_id,
467                role=role,
468                command=cmd_str,
469                exit_code=-1,
470                stdout="",
471                stderr=str(exc),
472                duration_seconds=dur,
473                success=False,
474                error_message=str(exc),
475            )

class GitBaseline(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
25@dataclass
26class GitBaseline(DataClassSerializationMixin):
27    """Snapshot of repository state before agent implementation begins."""
28
29    repo_root: str
30    initial_commit_sha: str
31    status_porcelain: str = ""
32    pre_existing_modified: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
33    pre_existing_untracked: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
34    # Byte snapshots of pre-existing modified/untracked files so a failed
35    # implementation attempt can be rolled back without losing user work.
36    # Only files below the configured size limit are retained.
37    pre_existing_snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
38    snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1024 * 1024
39    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
40    schema: str = GIT_BASELINE_SCHEMA_VERSION
41
42    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
43        d = asdict(self)
44        d["pre_existing_snapshots"] = {
45            k: base64.b64encode(v).decode("ascii")
46            for k, v in self.pre_existing_snapshots.items()
47        }
48        return d
49
50    @classmethod
51    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "GitBaseline":
52        d = dict(data)
53        raw_snapshots = d.pop("pre_existing_snapshots", {}) or {}
54        snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
55        for k, v in raw_snapshots.items():
56            if isinstance(v, str):
57                snapshots[k] = base64.b64decode(v)
58            elif isinstance(v, bytes):
59                snapshots[k] = v
60        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
61        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
62        return cls(pre_existing_snapshots=snapshots, **filtered)

def capture_baseline( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1048576) -> GitBaseline: 
139def capture_baseline(repo_dir: Union[str, Path], snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1024 * 1024) -> GitBaseline:
140    """Captures the initial state of the repository prior to task execution."""
141    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
142    sha_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
143    sha = sha_proc.stdout.strip() if sha_proc.returncode == 0 else "HEAD_UNKNOWN"
144
145    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
146    untracked, modified, _, _ = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
147
148    snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
149    for rel_path in modified | untracked:
150        abs_path = root / rel_path
151        snap = _snapshot_file(abs_path, snapshot_size_limit_bytes)
152        if snap is not None:
153            snapshots[rel_path] = snap
154
155    return GitBaseline(
156        repo_root=str(root),
157        initial_commit_sha=sha,
158        status_porcelain=status_out,
159        pre_existing_modified=sorted(list(modified)),
160        pre_existing_untracked=sorted(list(untracked)),
161        pre_existing_snapshots=snapshots,
162        snapshot_size_limit_bytes=snapshot_size_limit_bytes,
163    )

def capture_delta( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta: 
179def capture_delta(repo_dir: Union[str, Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta:
180    """Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt."""
181    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
182    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
183    cur_untracked, cur_modified, cur_deleted, cur_added = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
184
185    pre_untracked = set(baseline.pre_existing_untracked)
186    pre_modified = set(baseline.pre_existing_modified)
187
188    task_added = sorted(list((cur_untracked - pre_untracked) | (cur_added - pre_modified)))
189    task_deleted = sorted(list(cur_deleted - pre_modified))
190    task_modified = sorted(list(cur_modified - pre_modified))
191    excluded = sorted(list((cur_untracked & pre_untracked) | (cur_modified & pre_modified)))
192
193    diffs: List[str] = []
194    tracked_changed = sorted(list(set(task_modified + task_deleted + [f for f in task_added if f in cur_added])))
195    if tracked_changed:
196        d_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["diff", "HEAD", "--"] + tracked_changed)
197        if d_proc.returncode == 0 and d_proc.stdout.strip():
198            diffs.append(d_proc.stdout.strip())
199
200    for nf in task_added:
201        if nf in cur_untracked:
202            ch = _generate_untracked_diff(root, nf)
203            if ch.strip():
204                diffs.append(ch.strip())
205
206    full_diff = "\n\n".join(diffs) if diffs else ""
207    ins = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++"))
208    dels = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---"))
209    # Each hunk was stripped before joining, so the assembled patch ends without
210    # a newline and `git apply` rejects the whole file as corrupt at its last
211    # line. Preserved evidence has to be replayable -- a candidate that cannot
212    # be applied cannot be reviewed or verified (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Counts
213    # are taken above so this stays purely a serialization fix.
214    if full_diff:
215        full_diff += "\n"
216
217    return RepositoryDelta(
218        files_added=task_added,
219        files_modified=task_modified,
220        files_deleted=task_deleted,
221        diff_content=full_diff,
222        insertions=ins,
223        deletions=dels,
224        is_empty=not bool(task_added or task_modified or task_deleted or full_diff.strip()),
225        pre_existing_excluded=excluded,
226    )

Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt.

class TaskRouter: 
 49class TaskRouter:
 50    """
 51    Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities
 52    without making external API calls.
 53    """
 54
 55    def __init__(
 56        self,
 57        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 58        resource_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
 59    ):
 60        self.resource_pool = resource_pool
 61        self.registry = registry or (
 62            resource_pool.registry if resource_pool is not None else AgentRegistry()
 63        )
 64
 65    def recommend_resource(
 66        self,
 67        task: TaskSpec,
 68        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
 69        *,
 70        role: str,
 71        operator_preferences: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 72    ) -> CognitiveRecommendation:
 73        """Ranks only already eligible resources and grants no authority."""
 74        if not candidates:
 75            return CognitiveRecommendation(
 76                resource_id=None,
 77                reason="No policy and capability eligible candidates were supplied.",
 78            )
 79        by_resource = {
 80            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id: profile
 81            for profile in candidates
 82        }
 83        for preferred in operator_preferences or []:
 84            if preferred in by_resource:
 85                return CognitiveRecommendation(
 86                    resource_id=preferred,
 87                    reason="Explicit operator preference among eligible resources.",
 88                )
 89
 90        skills = set(task.required_skills)
 91        architectural = bool(skills.intersection({
 92            "architectural_guardrails",
 93            "systems_logic",
 94            "technical_writing",
 95            "cyber_security",
 96        }))
 97        autonomous = (
 98            "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools
 99            or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
100        )
101        ordered = sorted(
102            candidates,
103            key=lambda profile: profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
104        )
105        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or architectural:
106            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
107            if autonomous:
108                autonomous_tier = [
109                    profile for profile in tier
110                    if "autonomous_workflow" in profile.capabilities
111                ]
112                if autonomous_tier:
113                    tier = autonomous_tier
114            selected = (tier or ordered)[0]
115            reason = "Deterministic Tier 1 task and role recommendation."
116        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
117            local = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.cost_class == "free_local"]
118            selected = (local or ordered)[0]
119            reason = "Deterministic low risk local task recommendation."
120        else:
121            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
122            headless = [profile for profile in tier if profile.interface == "headless_cli"]
123            selected = (headless or tier or ordered)[0]
124            reason = f"Deterministic routing preference for role '{role}'."
125        return CognitiveRecommendation(
126            resource_id=selected.resource_id or selected.agent_id,
127            reason=reason,
128        )
129
130    def route(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
131        """
132        Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.
133        """
134        if self.resource_pool is not None:
135            return self._route_resource(task)
136        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
137
138        # 1. Check for human / policy override
139        if task.preferred_agent:
140            target = self.registry.get_agent(task.preferred_agent)
141            if target:
142                if target.availability == "available":
143                    return RoutingDecision(
144                        selected_agent_id=target.agent_id,
145                        selected_agent_name=target.name,
146                        reasoning_tier=target.reasoning_tier,
147                        rationale=(
148                            f"User/policy override explicitly requested agent '{target.agent_id}' ({target.name})."
149                        ),
150                        recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
151                        reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
152                        is_override=True,
153                        alternatives=[
154                            a.agent_id
155                            for a in self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
156                            if a.agent_id != target.agent_id
157                        ],
158                    )
159
160        # 2. Evaluate task risk, skills, and reasoning requirements
161        available_agents = self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
162        if not available_agents:
163            raise RuntimeError("No available agents found in the registry.")
164
165        skills = set(task.required_skills)
166        is_security = bool(
167            skills.intersection({"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"})
168        )
169        is_arch = bool(
170            skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"})
171        )
172        is_autonomous = "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
173
174        # 3. Apply deterministic decision matrix
175        selected_agent: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
176        rationale_lines: List[str] = []
177
178        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or is_security or is_arch:
179            # Tier 1 reasoning candidates
180            tier_1_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
181            if tier_1_agents:
182                # Prefer claude_code if orchestration/architecture, devin_cli if autonomous
183                if is_autonomous and any(a.agent_id == "devin_cli" for a in tier_1_agents):
184                    selected_agent = next(a for a in tier_1_agents if a.agent_id == "devin_cli")
185                    rationale_lines.append(
186                        "Selected Devin CLI for autonomous multi-step execution under high risk/tier 1 constraints."
187                    )
188                else:
189                    selected_agent = tier_1_agents[0]
190                    rationale_lines.append(
191                        f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for Tier 1 reasoning, architectural depth, and risk handling."
192                    )
193            else:
194                # Fall back to strongest Tier 2 agent
195                tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
196                selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0] if tier_2_agents else available_agents[0]
197                rationale_lines.append(
198                    f"Tier 1 requested but unavailable; routed to highest available Tier 2 agent: {selected_agent.name}."
199                )
200
201        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
202            # Local / low-cost candidates
203            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
204            if local_agents:
205                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
206                rationale_lines.append(
207                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
208                )
209            else:
210                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
211                rationale_lines.append(
212                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
213                )
214
215        else:
216            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
217            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
218            if tier_2_agents:
219                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
220                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
221                    selected_agent = next(
222                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
223                        tier_2_agents[0],
224                    )
225                else:
226                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
227                rationale_lines.append(
228                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
229                )
230            else:
231                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
232                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
233
234        # Build alternatives list
235        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
236
237        return RoutingDecision(
238            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
239            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
240            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
241            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
242            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
243            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
244            is_override=False,
245            alternatives=alternatives,
246        )
247
248    def _route_resource(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
249        """Routes through the shared resource pool without bypassing policy."""
250        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
251        decision = self.resource_pool.select_resource(
252            task,
253            role="implementation",
254            explicit_resource_id=task.preferred_agent,
255        )
256        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {
257            "resource_selection": decision.to_dict(),
258            "blocked_outcome": decision.blocked_outcome() if not decision.selected else None,
259        }
260        if decision.selected is None:
261            return RoutingDecision(
262                selected_agent_id="",
263                selected_agent_name="No eligible AI resource",
264                reasoning_tier=task.recommended_reasoning_tier,
265                rationale="No configured resource passed hard policy, readiness, capability, capacity, and economic filtering.",
266                recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
267                reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
268                is_override=bool(task.preferred_agent),
269                metadata=metadata,
270            )
271
272        selected = self.registry.get_resource(decision.selected.resource_id)
273        reviewer_mapping, diversity = self.resource_pool.select_reviewers(
274            decision.selected.resource_id,
275            reviewers,
276            task=task,
277        )
278        metadata.update({
279            "reviewer_resource_mapping": reviewer_mapping,
280            "reviewer_resource_identities": {
281                role: self.registry.get_resource(resource_id).resource_identity().to_dict()
282                for role, resource_id in reviewer_mapping.items()
283                if self.registry.get_resource(resource_id) is not None
284            },
285            "review_diversity_achieved": diversity,
286        })
287        recommendation = decision.cognitive_recommendation
288        return RoutingDecision(
289            selected_agent_id=decision.selected.resource_id,
290            selected_agent_name=selected.name if selected else decision.selected.resource_id,
291            reasoning_tier=selected.reasoning_tier if selected else task.recommended_reasoning_tier,
292            rationale=(recommendation.reason if recommendation else "Deterministic resource selection."),
293            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
294            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
295            is_override=decision.explicit_override,
296            alternatives=[
297                identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources
298                if identity.resource_id != decision.selected.resource_id
299            ],
300            metadata=metadata,
301        )
302
303    def _select_reviewers(self, task: TaskSpec) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, str]]:
304        """
305        Determines the specialized reviewer roles required for the task and records explicit rationales.
306        """
307        reviewers: List[str] = []
308        reasons: Dict[str, str] = {}
309
310        def add_reviewer(role: str, reason: str):
311            if role not in reviewers:
312                reviewers.append(role)
313                reasons[role] = reason
314
315        # If the task explicitly lists required reviewers, honor that as the
316        # authoritative starting set instead of the default baseline. This lets
317        # special tasks (e.g., the live acceptance canary, which produces an
318        # evidence artifact rather than production code) avoid reviewers that
319        # are inappropriate for their scope, while preserving the security and
320        # risk-based additions below.
321        if task.reviewer_requirements:
322            for req in task.reviewer_requirements:
323                add_reviewer(req, "Explicitly required by TaskSpec reviewer_requirements.")
324        else:
325            # Baseline reviewers for ordinary tasks
326            add_reviewer("correctness-reviewer", "Baseline correctness, edge cases, and acceptance contract verification.")
327            add_reviewer("test-falsifier", "Adversarial test verification, missing negative branch and vacuous assertion checks.")
328
329        skills = set(task.required_skills)
330        if task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or skills.intersection(
331            {"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"}
332        ):
333            add_reviewer("security-reviewer", "Triggered by high/critical risk level or security-related skill requirements.")
334
335        if skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"}) or task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1":
336            add_reviewer("architecture-reviewer", "Triggered by Tier 1 reasoning requirement or architectural skill requirements.")
337
338        if task.risk_level in ("medium", "high", "critical"):
339            add_reviewer("regression-reviewer", "Triggered by medium/high/critical risk scope to protect existing contracts and call sites.")
340
341        # Simplicity reviewer for refactoring or multi-file work
342        add_reviewer("simplicity-reviewer", "Minimal diff review to prevent overengineering and eliminate dead code.")
343
344        return reviewers, reasons

202            # Local / low-cost candidates
203            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
204            if local_agents:
205                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
206                rationale_lines.append(
207                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
208                )
209            else:
210                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
211                rationale_lines.append(
212                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
213                )
214
215        else:
216            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
217            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
218            if tier_2_agents:
219                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
220                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
221                    selected_agent = next(
222                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
223                        tier_2_agents[0],
224                    )
225                else:
226                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
227                rationale_lines.append(
228                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
229                )
230            else:
231                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
232                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
233
234        # Build alternatives list
235        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
236
237        return RoutingDecision(
238            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
239            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
240            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
241            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
242            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
243            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
244            is_override=False,
245            alternatives=alternatives,
246        )

Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.

REVIEWER_ROLES = {'correctness-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='correctness-reviewer', name='Correctness Reviewer', focus_areas=['correctness', 'edge_cases', 'contract_compliance', 'error_handling'], falsification_goal='Produce a concrete input or state where code violates requirements, fails on edge cases, or contains logic bugs.', prompt_template='You are an independent Correctness Reviewer. Your role is strictly adversarial to buggy code.\nDo NOT assume the code works just because it appears clean or passes basic tests.\nYour primary objective is to produce a concrete input, state, or execution path where behavior violates requirements or logic:\n1. Logic bugs, off-by-one errors, inverse condition checks, incorrect boolean logic.\n2. Unhandled edge cases (None/null, empty collections, negative numbers, timeouts, unexpected types).\n3. Mismatches where the code fails to strictly fulfill an acceptance criterion.\n4. Broken error handling or swallowed exceptions that mask underlying failures.\n5. Incomplete state transitions or unhandled error recovery states.\n'), 'regression-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='regression-reviewer', name='Regression Reviewer', focus_areas=['regression', 'backwards_compatibility', 'call_sites', 'contract_drift'], falsification_goal='Identify previously valid behavior, caller contracts, or configurations broken by this change.', prompt_template='You are an independent Regression Reviewer. Your job is to protect existing functionality from breakage.\nDo NOT evaluate whether the new feature is nice; evaluate what previously valid behavior is now broken.\nSearch specifically for:\n1. Breaking changes to function/method signatures, interfaces, or return types.\n2. Deleted or renamed attributes/variables still referenced elsewhere in the repository.\n3. Behavior changes for existing callers under default parameters or existing workflows.\n4. Schema migrations, configuration drifts, or altered environment assumptions.\n5. Inadvertently altered public contracts or library APIs.\n'), 'security-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='security-reviewer', name='Security Reviewer', focus_areas=['security', 'vulnerabilities', 'credentials', 'injection', 'authorization'], falsification_goal='Identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, or fail-open logic.', prompt_template='You are an independent Security Reviewer. Your job is to identify security vulnerabilities, credential leaks, and unsafe patterns.\nAttempt to identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, injection surfaces, or fail-open behavior:\n1. Hardcoded secrets, API keys, credentials, PII, or internal tokens.\n2. Unsafe command execution, unescaped shell interpolations (`shell=True`, bash backtick injection, subprocess without list args).\n3. Missing input validation, path traversal (`../`), unconstrained deserialization, or unvalidated file writes.\n4. Authorization flaws, bypasses of human approval gates, or fail-open authorization logic.\n5. Insecure defaults or sensitive data leakage in logs or exceptions.\n'), 'test-falsifier': ReviewerRole(role_id='test-falsifier', name='Test Falsifier', focus_areas=['test_gap', 'vacuous_tests', 'mock_fidelity', 'untested_branches'], falsification_goal='Prove the test suite is inadequate or construct a broken implementation that still passes tests.', prompt_template="You are an independent Test Falsifier. Tests that pass vacuously (e.g. asserting `True`, asserting on mocked objects without calling real code).\n2. Mock paths that don't match reality (e.g. patching an object where it's defined rather than where it's imported, or over-mocking).\n3. Missing negative test cases: error paths, timeouts, boundary inputs, malformed schemas, fail-closed assertions.\n4. Code implementations that pass the test suite while violating the true task requirements.\n"), 'architecture-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='architecture-reviewer', name='Architecture Reviewer', focus_areas=['architecture', 'coupling', 'abstraction_quality', 'boundary_discipline'], falsification_goal='Identify structural coupling, leaky abstractions, and layering violations that materially raise risk.', prompt_template="You are an independent Architecture Reviewer. Your role is to maintain system integrity and prevent architectural erosion.\nIdentify boundary violations or coupling that materially raises maintenance or correctness risk:\n1. Unnecessary coupling between unrelated modules or circular dependencies.\n2. Leaky abstractions or single-caller abstractions that add indirection without value.\n3. Violations of the repository's established layer boundaries (e.g. domain vs infrastructure vs orchestration).\n4. Code that should live in a reusable module but was copy-pasted across multiple locations.\nNOTE: Do NOT complain about style unless it materially affects architecture or correctness.\n"), 'simplicity-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='simplicity-reviewer', name='Simplicity Reviewer', focus_areas=['simplicity', 'minimal_diff', 'complexity_elimination', 'dead_code'], falsification_goal='Prove the solution contains unnecessary moving parts and find smaller, simpler alternatives.', prompt_template='You are an independent Simplicity Reviewer. Opportunities to solve the same problem with significantly fewer lines of diff.\n4. Redundant boilerplate that obscures business logic.\nNOTE: Do NOT propose rewrites merely for elegance; focus on removing actual excess complexity.\n')}

class ReviewRunner: 
399class ReviewRunner:
400    """Orchestrates independent review runs, output parsing, and reconciliation."""
401
402    @classmethod
403    def execute_review_cycle(
404        cls,
405        task: TaskSpec,
406        diff_content: str,
407        reviewer_roles: List[str],
408        cwd: Union[str, Path],
409        backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
410        cycle_index: int = 1,
411        reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
412        custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None,
413        run_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
414        provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
415        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
416    ) -> ReviewCycleResult:
417        """
418        Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff.
419        Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.
420
421        `provider_pool` is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer
422        whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output
423        gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via
424        `invoke_reviewer_with_failover`, mirroring implementation failover.
425        Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised
426        before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior
427        exactly.
428        """
429        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
430        reviewer_results: Dict[str, SingleReviewResult] = {}
431        all_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
432        has_failure = False
433
434        skill_context = build_skill_context(task)
435
436        # Establish cycle directory for incremental checkpointing
437        cycle_dir: Optional[Path] = None
438        if run_dir:
439            r_path = Path(run_dir).resolve()
440            if cycle_index == 1:
441                cycle_dir = r_path / "reviews"
442            else:
443                cycle_dir = r_path / "remediation" / f"cycle-{cycle_index - 1:02d}" / "re_review"
444            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
445
446        for role_id in reviewer_roles:
447            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
448            role_name = role.name if role else role_id
449
450            # Check if this reviewer already completed in a previous interrupted run
451            cached_result: Optional[SingleReviewResult] = None
452            if cycle_dir:
453                cached_md = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
454                cached_yaml = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml"
455                if cached_md.is_file() and cached_yaml.is_file():
456                    try:
457                        c_raw = cached_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
458                        raw_data = yaml.safe_load(cached_yaml.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or []
459                        if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
460                            c_findings_data = raw_data.get("findings", [])
461                        elif isinstance(raw_data, list):
462                            c_findings_data = raw_data
463                        else:
464                            c_findings_data = []
465                        c_findings = [
466                            ReviewFinding.from_dict(f) if isinstance(f, dict) else f
467                            for f in c_findings_data
468                        ]
469                        cached_result = SingleReviewResult(
470                            reviewer_role=role_id,
471                            reviewer_name=role_name,
472                            status="findings_detected" if c_findings else "clean",
473                            findings=c_findings,
474                            raw_output=c_raw,
475                            error_message=None,
476                            duration_seconds=0.0,
477                        )
478                    except Exception:
479                        cached_result = None
480
481            if cached_result is not None:
482                reviewer_results[role_id] = cached_result
483                all_findings.extend(cached_result.findings)
484                continue
485
486            # Render brief with the REAL implementation diff and skill context
487            brief = (
488                role.render_brief(task=task, diff_content=diff_content, context=skill_context)
489                if role
490                else f"# Review Brief for {role_id}\n{skill_context or ''}\n```diff\n{diff_content}\n```"
491            )
492
493            raw_output = ""
494            err_message = None
495            agent_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
496            duration = 0.0
497
498            attempts_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
499            assigned_agent = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
500            if backend:
501                assigned_agent = getattr(backend, "agent_id", assigned_agent)
502
503            from src.control_plane.progress import track_operation
504            with track_operation(
505                progress_tracker,
506                phase="REVIEWING",
507                resource_id=assigned_agent,
508                role="review",
509                cycle=cycle_index,
510                details=f"cycle {cycle_index}",
511            ):
512                if custom_reviewer_fn:
513                    try:
514                        raw_output = custom_reviewer_fn(role_id, diff_content, task)
515                    except Exception as exc:
516                        err_message = str(exc)
517                        has_failure = True
518                elif provider_pool is not None and not backend:
519                    candidates = build_reviewer_candidates(role_id, assigned_agent, provider_pool, task)
520                    winner, agent_res, attempts_log = invoke_reviewer_with_failover(
521                        role_id=role_id,
522                        candidates=candidates,
523                        task=task,
524                        cwd=target_cwd,
525                        prompt_override=brief,
526                        backend_lookup=lambda aid: AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(aid),
527                        provider_pool=provider_pool,
528                    )
529                    duration = agent_res.duration_seconds if agent_res else 0.0
530                    if winner and agent_res:
531                        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
532                    else:
533                        err_message = "All candidate reviewers failed or were unavailable"
534                        has_failure = True
535                else:
536                    selected_backend = backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(assigned_agent)
537                    agent_res = selected_backend.execute(
538                        task=task,
539                        cwd=target_cwd,
540                        role=role_id,
541                        prompt_override=brief,
542                        timeout_seconds=REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
543                    )
544                    duration = agent_res.duration_seconds
545                    if agent_res.success:
546                        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
547                    else:
548                        err_message = agent_res.stderr or agent_res.error_message
549                        has_failure = True
550
551            findings, parse_err, is_valid_output = parse_and_validate_findings(raw_output, role_id)
552            if parse_err:
553                has_failure = True
554                status = "malformed_output"
555            elif err_message:
556                status = "reviewer_failure"
557            elif findings:
558                status = "findings_detected"
559            elif not is_valid_output:
560                has_failure = True
561                status = "output_invalid"
562            else:
563                status = "clean"
564
565            single_res = SingleReviewResult(
566                reviewer_role=role_id,
567                reviewer_name=role_name,
568                status=status,
569                findings=findings,
570                raw_output=raw_output,
571                error_message=err_message or parse_err,
572                duration_seconds=duration,
573                agent_result=agent_res,
574                attempts=attempts_log,
575            )
576            reviewer_results[role_id] = single_res
577            all_findings.extend(findings)
578
579            # Persist individual reviewer artifact incrementally
580            if cycle_dir:
581                try:
582                    from src.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text, atomic_write_yaml
583                    atomic_write_text(cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md", raw_output)
584                    atomic_write_yaml(
585                        cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml",
586                        [f.to_dict() for f in findings],
587                        sort_keys=False,
588                    )
589                except Exception:
590                    pass
591
592        # Run reconciliation across all gathered findings
593        reconciliation = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(all_findings) if all_findings else None
594
595        # Check if remediation is needed: unresolved blockers > 0, unresolved highs
596        # > 0, or any reviewer failed to complete (#59.2 Phase 3). A reviewer that
597        # never ran/parsed successfully must never be silently indistinguishable
598        # from "ran cleanly, found nothing" -- has_failure alone must gate here,
599        # independent of whether any findings exist to reconcile.
600        requires_remediation = False
601        if has_failure:
602            requires_remediation = True
603        if reconciliation:
604            if reconciliation.unresolved_blockers > 0 or reconciliation.unresolved_highs > 0:
605                requires_remediation = True
606            elif reconciliation.confirmed or reconciliation.likely:
607                requires_remediation = True
608
609        overall_status = "review_failure" if has_failure else ("has_findings" if all_findings else "clean")
610
611        return ReviewCycleResult(
612            cycle_index=cycle_index,
613            reviewer_results=reviewer_results,
614            all_findings=all_findings,
615            reconciliation=reconciliation,
616            status=overall_status,
617            requires_remediation=requires_remediation,
618        )
619
620    @classmethod
621    def determine_re_review_roles(
622        cls,
623        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
624        original_roles: List[str],
625    ) -> List[str]:
626        """
627        Deterministically selects targeted reviewers for re-review after remediation.
628        """
629        if not findings:
630            return list(original_roles)
631
632        selected: Set[str] = set()
633        for f in findings:
634            cat = (f.category or "").lower()
635            role = f.reviewer_role
636
637            if role:
638                selected.add(role)
639
640            if cat in ("security", "vuln", "auth"):
641                selected.update(["security-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
642            elif cat in ("architecture", "coupling", "boundary"):
643                selected.update(["architecture-reviewer", "regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
644            elif cat in ("regression", "breaking_change"):
645                selected.update(["regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
646            elif cat in ("test_gap", "missing_test", "vacuous_test"):
647                selected.update(["test-falsifier", "correctness-reviewer"])
648            elif cat in ("simplicity", "complexity", "dead_code"):
649                selected.update(["simplicity-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
650            else:
651                selected.update(["correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
652
653        # Filter against available original roles or known reviewer roles
654        target_roles = [r for r in original_roles if r in selected]
655        if not target_roles:
656            target_roles = list(selected)
657        return sorted(list(set(target_roles)))

Orchestrates independent review runs, output parsing, and reconciliation.

@classmethod

Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff. Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.

provider_pool is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via invoke_reviewer_with_failover, mirroring implementation failover. Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior exactly.

def parse_and_validate_findings( raw_output: str, reviewer_role: str) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]: 
151def parse_and_validate_findings(
152    raw_output: str,
153    reviewer_role: str,
154) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]:
155    """
156    Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output.
157    Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output).
158    If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.
159
160    `is_valid_output` is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that
161    was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such
162    output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and
163    reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).
164    """
165    if not raw_output or not raw_output.strip():
166        # Empty output is never evidence of a completed clean review.
167        return [], None, False
168
169    clean_text = raw_output.strip()
170
171    # Extract yaml / json code block if wrapped in markdown
172    code_block_match = re.search(r"```(?:yaml|json)?\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```", clean_text)
173    if code_block_match:
174        payload_text = code_block_match.group(1).strip()
175    elif _is_recognized_clean_phrase(clean_text):
176        # Unfenced natural-language prose reporting a clean result: accept it
177        # directly rather than risk yaml.safe_load misreading its bullet
178        # points/colons as an unrelated structured (and thus malformed) shape.
179        return [], None, True
180    else:
181        payload_text = clean_text
182
183    try:
184        parsed = yaml.safe_load(payload_text)
185    except Exception as exc:
186        err_msg = f"Malformed reviewer output YAML: {exc}"
187        failure_finding = ReviewFinding(
188            id=f"ERR-{reviewer_role[:4].upper()}-001",
189            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
190            title=f"Malformed reviewer output from {reviewer_role}",
191            severity="high",
192            category="other",
193            description=f"Reviewer output failed schema validation: {err_msg}",
194            status="open",
195            claim="Reviewer produced unparseable output format",
196            evidence=raw_output[:500],
197        )
198        return [failure_finding], err_msg, False
199
200    if parsed is None:
201        # Output existed but carried no structured content (e.g. an empty
202        # code block) -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
203        return [], None, False
204
205    # Normalization of parsed content
206    findings_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
207    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
208        if "findings" in parsed:
209            raw_f = parsed.get("findings")
210            if isinstance(raw_f, list):
211                findings_list = raw_f
212            elif raw_f is None:
213                findings_list = []
214            else:
215                err_msg = f"'findings' field in output must be a list, got {type(raw_f)}"
216                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
217        else:
218            # Maybe single finding object
219            if "title" in parsed or "severity" in parsed:
220                findings_list = [parsed]
221            elif not parsed:
222                # Empty dict -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
223                return [], None, False
224            else:
225                err_msg = "Reviewer dictionary output missing 'findings' list"
226                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
227    elif isinstance(parsed, list):
228        findings_list = parsed
229    elif isinstance(parsed, str) and _is_recognized_clean_phrase(parsed):
230        # An explicit prose "clean" signal is a deliberate, valid result.
231        return [], None, True
232    else:
233        err_msg = f"Unexpected reviewer output type: {type(parsed)}"
234        return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
235
236    validated_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
237    for idx, item in enumerate(findings_list, 1):
238        if not isinstance(item, dict):
239            err_msg = f"Finding at index {idx} is not a valid dictionary"
240            return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
241
242        f_id = str(item.get("id") or f"F{idx:03d}")
243        title = str(item.get("title") or f"Issue found by {reviewer_role}")
244        severity = str(item.get("severity") or "medium").lower().strip()
245        if severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
246            severity = "medium"
247
248        category = str(item.get("category") or "correctness").lower().strip()
249        description = str(item.get("description") or item.get("claim") or title)
250        location = item.get("location")
251        claim = item.get("claim")
252        evidence = item.get("evidence")
253        suggested_fix = item.get("suggested_fix")
254        component = item.get("component")
255
256        finding = ReviewFinding(
257            id=f_id,
258            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
259            title=title,
260            severity=severity,
261            category=category,
262            description=description,
263            component=component,
264            claim=claim,
265            location=location,
266            evidence=evidence,
267            suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
268            status="open",
269        )
270        validated_findings.append(finding)
271
272    # Reaching here means the output was a structurally valid findings
273    # container (an explicit list, a `findings:` key, or `findings: null`),
274    # even when validated_findings ends up empty -- a deliberate clean signal.
275    return validated_findings, None, True

Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output. Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output). If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.

is_valid_output is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).

@dataclass
class ReviewFinding(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
38@dataclass
39class ReviewFinding(DataClassSerializationMixin):
40    """Represents a single finding discovered during review."""
41
42    id: str
43    reviewer_role: str
44    title: str
45    severity: str
46    category: str
47    description: str
48    status: str = "open"
49    component: Optional[str] = None
50    claim: Optional[str] = None
51    location: Optional[str] = None
52    evidence: Optional[str] = None
53    suggested_fix: Optional[str] = None
54    related_finding_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
55    redundancy_status: str = "independent"  # "independent", "duplicate", "overlapping"
56    resolution_reason: Optional[str] = None
57    schema: str = REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION
58
59    def __post_init__(self):
60        self.validate()
61
62    def validate(self) -> None:
63        if not self.id or not isinstance(self.id, str):
64            raise ReconciliationValidationError("Finding id must be a non-empty string.")
65        if self.severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
66            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
67                f"Finding severity '{self.severity}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_SEVERITIES)}"
68            )
69        if self.status not in VALID_FINDING_STATUSES:
70            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
71                f"Finding status '{self.status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_FINDING_STATUSES)}"
72            )
73        if self.redundancy_status not in VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES:
74            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
75                f"redundancy_status '{self.redundancy_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES)}"
76            )
77
78        # Rule: Any dismissed blocker or high finding must have a resolution reason
79        if self.status in ("false_positive", "out_of_scope") and self.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
80            if not self.resolution_reason or not self.resolution_reason.strip():
81                raise ReconciliationValidationError(
82                    f"Finding '{self.id}' with severity '{self.severity}' cannot be marked '{self.status}' "
83                    "without an explicit non-empty resolution_reason."
84                )
85
86    @classmethod
87    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ReviewFinding":
88        d = dict(data)
89        d.pop("schema", None)
90        return cls(schema=REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION, **d)

Represents a single finding discovered during review.

62    def validate(self) -> None:
63        if not self.id or not isinstance(self.id, str):
64            raise ReconciliationValidationError("Finding id must be a non-empty string.")
65        if self.severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
66            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
67                f"Finding severity '{self.severity}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_SEVERITIES)}"
68            )
69        if self.status not in VALID_FINDING_STATUSES:
70            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
71                f"Finding status '{self.status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_FINDING_STATUSES)}"
72            )
73        if self.redundancy_status not in VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES:
74            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
75                f"redundancy_status '{self.redundancy_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES)}"
76            )
77
78        # Rule: Any dismissed blocker or high finding must have a resolution reason
79        if self.status in ("false_positive", "out_of_scope") and self.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
80            if not self.resolution_reason or not self.resolution_reason.strip():
81                raise ReconciliationValidationError(
82                    f"Finding '{self.id}' with severity '{self.severity}' cannot be marked '{self.status}' "
83                    "without an explicit non-empty resolution_reason."
84                )

131    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
132        """Generates a human-readable reconciliation report."""
133        lines = [
134            "# Review Reconciliation Report",
135            "",
136            "## Summary",
137            f"- **Total findings:** {len(self.findings)}",
138            f"- **Confirmed findings:** {len(self.confirmed)}",
139            f"- **Likely findings:** {len(self.likely)}",
140            f"- **Disputed findings:** {len(self.disputed)}",
141            f"- **Requires human judgment:** {len(self.requires_human_judgment)}",
142            f"- **False positives (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.false_positives)}",
143            f"- **Out of scope (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.out_of_scope)}",
144            f"- **Duplicates detected:** {self.duplicate_count}",
145            f"- **Overlapping findings:** {self.overlapping_count}",
146            f"- **Unresolved Blockers / Highs:** {self.unresolved_blockers + self.unresolved_highs}",
147            "",
148            "## Findings & Unique Signal by Reviewer Role",
149            "| Reviewer Role | Total Findings | Unique Findings | Duplicates / Overlaps |",
150            "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
151        ]
152        for role, total in sorted(self.findings_by_role.items()):
153            unique = self.unique_findings_by_role.get(role, 0)
154            dups = total - unique
155            lines.append(f"| `{role}` | {total} | {unique} | {dups} |")
156        lines.append("")
157
158        if self.confirmed:
159            lines.append("## Confirmed Findings (Multi-Reviewer Agreement / Verified)")
160            for f in self.confirmed:
161                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
162                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
163                if f.location:
164                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
165                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
166                if f.suggested_fix:
167                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
168            lines.append("")
169
170        if self.likely:
171            lines.append("## Likely Findings (Single Reviewer High Confidence)")
172            for f in self.likely:
173                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
174                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
175                if f.location:
176                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
177                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
178                if f.suggested_fix:
179                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
180            lines.append("")
181
182        if self.disputed:
183            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
184            for f in self.disputed:
185                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
186                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
187                if f.resolution_reason:
188                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
189            lines.append("")
190
191        if self.requires_human_judgment:
192            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
193            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
194                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
195                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
196            lines.append("")
197
198        return "\n".join(lines)
