class ReviewReconciler: 
201class ReviewReconciler:
202    """Performs deterministic reconciliation of multi-agent review findings."""
203
204    @staticmethod
205    def reconcile(findings: List[ReviewFinding]) -> ReconciliationResult:
206        """
207        Reconciles a collection of review findings into classified categories.
208        Ensures all validations pass and preserves every disagreement.
209        """
210        # Validate all findings first
211        for f in findings:
212            f.validate()
213
214        confirmed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
215        likely: List[ReviewFinding] = []
216        disputed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
217        false_positives: List[ReviewFinding] = []
218        out_of_scope: List[ReviewFinding] = []
219        requires_human: List[ReviewFinding] = []
220
221        unresolved_blockers = 0
222        unresolved_highs = 0
223        duplicate_count = 0
224        overlapping_count = 0
225        findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
226        unique_findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
227
228        # Index findings by location and component
229        location_map: Dict[str, List[ReviewFinding]] = {}
230        for f in findings:
231            findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
232            if f.location:
233                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
234                location_map.setdefault(loc_key, []).append(f)
235
236        # Detect cross-reviewer duplicates and overlaps
237        processed_pairs = set()
238        for f in findings:
239            if f.location:
240                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
241                co_located = location_map.get(loc_key, [])
242                distinct_reviewers = {other.reviewer_role for other in co_located if other.id != f.id}
243
244                if distinct_reviewers:
245                    # Match found across different reviewer roles
246                    other_findings = [other for other in co_located if other.id != f.id]
247                    for other in other_findings:
248                        pair = tuple(sorted([f.id, other.id]))
249                        if pair not in processed_pairs:
250                            processed_pairs.add(pair)
251                            if other.id not in f.related_finding_ids:
252                                f.related_finding_ids.append(other.id)
253                            if f.id not in other.related_finding_ids:
254                                other.related_finding_ids.append(f.id)
255
256                    # Determine redundancy classification
257                    if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
258                        # If first finding for this location, mark overlapping; if subsequent, duplicate
259                        first_for_loc = co_located[0].id == f.id
260                        if first_for_loc:
261                            f.redundancy_status = "overlapping"
262                            overlapping_count += 1
263                        else:
264                            f.redundancy_status = "duplicate"
265                            duplicate_count += 1
266                else:
267                    if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
268                        duplicate_count += 1
269                    elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
270                        overlapping_count += 1
271            else:
272                if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
273                    duplicate_count += 1
274                elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
275                    overlapping_count += 1
276
277            if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
278                unique_findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = unique_findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
279
280        for f in findings:
281            # Check if status was already set or should be deduced
282            if f.status == "open":
283                # Auto-classification logic
284                loc_matches = location_map.get(f.location.strip().lower(), []) if f.location else []
285                reviewers_at_loc = {m.reviewer_role for m in loc_matches}
286
287                if len(reviewers_at_loc) > 1:
288                    # Multiple distinct reviewers flagged this location
289                    f.status = "confirmed"
290                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.category == "security":
291                    f.status = "requires_human_judgment"
292                    f.resolution_reason = "Security-critical finding automatically routed for human verification."
293                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
294                    f.status = "likely"
295                else:
296                    f.status = "likely"
297
298            # Sort into buckets
299            if f.status == "confirmed":
300                confirmed.append(f)
301            elif f.status == "likely":
302                likely.append(f)
303            elif f.status == "disputed":
304                disputed.append(f)
305            elif f.status == "false_positive":
306                false_positives.append(f)
307            elif f.status == "out_of_scope":
308                out_of_scope.append(f)
309            elif f.status == "requires_human_judgment":
310                requires_human.append(f)
311
312            # Count unresolved severe items
313            if f.status in ("confirmed", "likely", "disputed", "requires_human_judgment"):
314                if f.severity == "blocker":
315                    unresolved_blockers += 1
316                elif f.severity == "high":
317                    unresolved_highs += 1
318
319        return ReconciliationResult(
320            findings=findings,
321            confirmed=confirmed,
322            likely=likely,
323            disputed=disputed,
324            false_positives=false_positives,
325            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
326            requires_human_judgment=requires_human,
327            unresolved_blockers=unresolved_blockers,
328            unresolved_highs=unresolved_highs,
329            duplicate_count=duplicate_count,
330            overlapping_count=overlapping_count,
331            unique_findings_by_role=unique_findings_by_role,
332            findings_by_role=findings_by_role,
333        )

129@dataclass
130class VerificationPlan(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents the complete verification suite for a task or project."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    steps: List[VerificationStep] = field(default_factory=list)
135    overall_status: str = "unverified"
136    schema: str = VERIFICATION_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION
137
138    def __post_init__(self):
139        self.validate()
140
141    def validate(self) -> None:
142        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
143            raise VerificationError("task_id must be a non-empty string.")
144        if self.overall_status not in VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES:
145            raise VerificationError(
146                f"overall_status '{self.overall_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES)}"
147            )
148        for s in self.steps:
149            s.validate()
150
151    def add_step(
152        self,
153        step_id: str,
154        name: str,
155        command: Union[str, List[str]],
156        category: str = "unit_test",
157        required: bool = True,
158        interpreter: Optional[str] = None,
159        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
160    ) -> None:
161        step = VerificationStep(
162            step_id=step_id,
163            name=name,
164            command=command,
165            category=category,
166            status="claimed",
167            required=required,
168            interpreter=interpreter,
169            metadata=metadata or {},
170        )
171        self.steps.append(step)
172
173    def execute_step(
174        self,
175        step: VerificationStep,
176        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
177        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
178    ) -> None:
179        """
180        Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True.
181        Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates.
182        Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).
183        """
184        step.status = "tested"
185        cmd_args: List[str]
186        if isinstance(step.command, str):
187            cmd_args = shlex.split(step.command)
188        else:
189            cmd_args = list(step.command)
190
191        start_time = time.time()
192        env = os.environ.copy()
193        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
194
195        # Hygiene provider integrity check
196        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
197            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
198                executable_name="slopslint",
199                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
200            )
201            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
202            if not ok:
203                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
204                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
205                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
206                step.status = "failed"
207                return
208            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
209            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
210                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
211
212        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
213        try:
214            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
215            step.interpreter = resolved_py
216            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
217            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
218            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
219                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
220        except Exception:
221            step.interpreter = sys.executable
222
223        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
224        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
225            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
226        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
227            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
228            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
229                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
230
231        cmd_display = (
232            " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
233            if isinstance(cmd_args, list)
234            else str(cmd_args)
235        )
236
237        from src.control_plane.progress import track_operation
238        try:
239            with track_operation(
240                progress_tracker,
241                phase="VERIFYING",
242                resource_id=step.category,
243                details=cmd_display,
244                role="verification",
245            ):
246                res = subprocess.run(
247                    cmd_args,
248                    cwd=cwd,
249                    capture_output=True,
250                    text=True,
251                    env=env,
252                    timeout=300,
253                )
254
255            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
256            step.exit_code = res.returncode
257            step.stdout = res.stdout
258            step.stderr = res.stderr
259            step.status = "observed"
260
261            if res.returncode == 0:
262                step.status = "verified"
263            else:
264                step.status = "failed"
265
266        except Exception as e:
267            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
268            step.exit_code = -1
269            step.stderr = str(e)
270            step.status = "failed"
271
272    def execute_all(
273        self,
274        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
275        stop_on_failure: bool = False,
276        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
277    ) -> str:
278        """
279        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
280        """
281        any_failed = False
282        all_passed = True
283
284        for step in self.steps:
285            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd, progress_tracker=progress_tracker)
286            if step.status == "failed":
287                any_failed = True
288                if step.required:
289                    all_passed = False
290                if stop_on_failure:
291                    break
292            elif step.status != "verified":
293                all_passed = False
294
295        if any_failed:
296            self.overall_status = "failed"
297        elif all_passed:
298            self.overall_status = "passed"
299        else:
300            self.overall_status = "partial"
301
302        return self.overall_status
303
304    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
305        return {
306            "schema": self.schema,
307            "task_id": self.task_id,
308            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
309            "steps": [s.to_dict() for s in self.steps],
310        }
311
312    @classmethod
313    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "VerificationPlan":
314        steps_data = data.get("steps", [])
315        steps = [VerificationStep.from_dict(item) for item in steps_data]
316        return cls(
317            task_id=data.get("task_id", ""),
318            steps=steps,
319            overall_status=data.get("overall_status", "unverified"),
320        )

112class EvidenceLedger:
113    """Manages the append-only evidence ledger log files."""
114
115    def __init__(self, ledger_file: Optional[str] = None):
116        if ledger_file is None:
117            # Default to logs/control_plane/evidence_ledger.jsonl
118            repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
119            ledger_file = str(repo_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
120        self.ledger_file = Path(ledger_file)
121        self.ledger_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
122
123    def append_entry(self, entry: EvidenceEntry) -> None:
124        """Appends a new sanitized entry to the JSON Lines log."""
125        line = json.dumps(entry.to_dict()) + "\n"
126        with open(self.ledger_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
127            f.write(line)
128
129    def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
130        """Reads all entries from the ledger."""
131        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
132            return []
133        entries = []
134        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
135            for line in f:
136                line = line.strip()
137                if line:
138                    try:
139                        entries.append(EvidenceEntry.from_dict(json.loads(line)))
140                    except Exception:
141                        continue
142        return entries
143
144    def get_task_entries(self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
145        """Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id."""
146        return [e for e in self.list_all_entries() if e.task_id == task_id]

127            f.write(line)

Appends a new sanitized entry to the JSON Lines log.

def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]: 
129    def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
130        """Reads all entries from the ledger."""
131        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
132            return []
133        entries = []
134        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
135            for line in f:
136                line = line.strip()
137                if line:
138                    try:
139                        entries.append(EvidenceEntry.from_dict(json.loads(line)))
140                    except Exception:
141                        continue
142        return entries

Reads all entries from the ledger.

def get_task_entries( self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]: 
144    def get_task_entries(self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
145        """Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id."""
146        return [e for e in self.list_all_entries() if e.task_id == task_id]

Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id.

def redact_sensitive_data(text: str) -> str: 
33def redact_sensitive_data(text: str) -> str:
34    """Scans and scrubs secrets, credentials, and PII from text."""
35    if not isinstance(text, str):
36        return text
37    sanitized = text
38    for pattern, replacement in REDACTION_PATTERNS:
39        sanitized = pattern.sub(replacement, sanitized)
40    return sanitized

Scans and scrubs secrets, credentials, and PII from text.

177    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
178        """Renders the metrics summary in standard operational format."""
179        fps_pct = (self.first_pass_successes / self.total_tasks * 100) if self.total_tasks > 0 else 0.0
180        lines = [
181            "# Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane Operational Report",
182            "",
183            "## Aggregate Overview",
184            f"- **Repositories exercised:** {len(self.repositories_exercised)}",
185            f"- **Tasks completed:** {self.completed_tasks}/{self.total_tasks}",
186            f"- **Tasks abandoned / failed:** {self.abandoned_tasks}",
187            f"- **First-pass success rate:** {fps_pct:.1f}% ({self.first_pass_successes}/{self.total_tasks} tasks)",
188            f"- **Tasks requiring remediation:** {self.tasks_requiring_remediation}",
189            f"- **Control-plane caught defects:** {self.control_plane_caught_defects} (Review: {self.review_caught_defects}, Verification: {self.verification_caught_defects}, Boundary: {self.boundary_caught_risks})",
190            f"- **Routing decisions:** {self.routing_recommendations_followed} recommended followed, {self.routing_overrides} operator overrides",
191            f"- **Human interventions required:** {self.human_interventions}",
192            "",
193            "## Implementation Agent Performance",
194            "| Agent | Worked | Completed | First-Pass Success | Remediation | Verif Failures | Findings Recv | Blockers | Human Gates |",
195            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
196        ]
197        for aid, summary in sorted(self.agent_summaries.items()):
198            fps_str = f"{summary.first_pass_success_rate * 100:.0f}%" if summary.tasks_worked >= MIN_ROUTING_SAMPLE_SIZE else f"{summary.first_pass_success_rate * 100:.0f}%*"
199            lines.append(
200                f"| `{aid}` | {summary.tasks_worked} | {summary.tasks_completed} | "
201                f"{fps_str} | {summary.remediation_cycles} | {summary.verification_failures} | "
202                f"{summary.review_findings_received} | {summary.blocker_findings_received} | {summary.human_interventions} |"
203            )
204        lines.append("")
205        lines.append(f"*\\*Note: Sample size < {MIN_ROUTING_SAMPLE_SIZE} indicates insufficient sample size for automated routing.*")
206        lines.append("")
207
208        lines.extend([
209            "## Reviewer Effectiveness & Marginal Value Breakdown",
210            "| Reviewer Role | Runs | Findings | Confirmed | Likely | False Pos | Disputed | Blockers | Unique | Triggered Fix | Prevented Bad Completion | Marginal Value |",
211            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
212        ])
213        for rid, rsum in sorted(self.reviewer_summaries.items()):
214            lines.append(
215                f"| `{rid}` | {rsum.reviewer_runs} | {rsum.findings_total} | {rsum.confirmed_findings} | "
216                f"{rsum.likely_findings} | {rsum.false_positives} | {rsum.disputed_findings} | {rsum.blockers_found} | "
217                f"{rsum.unique_findings} | {rsum.findings_that_triggered_remediation} | {rsum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion} | {rsum.marginal_value} |"
218            )
219        lines.append("")
220
221        if (
222            self.slop_checks_run > 0
223            or self.duplication_regressions_caught > 0
224            or self.debt_acceptance_requests > 0
225            or self.slop_findings_remediated > 0
226            or self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered > 0
227            or self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts > 0
228        ):
229            lines.extend([
230                "## Repository Hygiene & Slop Gate Tracking",
231                f"- **Hygiene checks executed:** {self.slop_checks_run} ({self.slop_checks_failed} failed)",
232                f"- **Duplication regressions caught:** {self.duplication_regressions_caught}",
233                f"- **Ceilings lowered (debt reduced):** {self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered}",
234                f"- **Ceiling raise attempts blocked:** {self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts}",
235                f"- **Policy tightenings:** {self.hygiene_policies_tightened}, **Weakenings requested:** {self.hygiene_policies_weakened}",
236                f"- **Tombstones added (debt accepted):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_added}, **Removed (cleaned):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_removed}",
237                f"- **Orphan surfaces caught:** {self.orphans_caught}",
238                f"- **Stale tombstones caught:** {self.stale_tombstones_caught}",
239                f"- **Contract / claims gaps caught:** {self.claim_gaps_caught}",
240                f"- **Provider integrity mismatches:** {self.hygiene_provider_mismatches}",
241                f"- **Slop findings remediated:** {self.slop_findings_remediated}",
242                f"- **Debt acceptance requests:** {self.debt_acceptance_requests} ({self.debt_acceptance_approved} approved, {self.debt_acceptance_rejected} rejected)",
243                "",
244            ])
245
246        if self.repositories_exercised:
247            lines.extend([
248                "## Repositories Exercised Breakdown",
249                "| Repository | Tasks Recorded |",
250                "| --- | --- |",
251            ])
252            for repo, count in sorted(self.repositories_exercised.items()):
253                lines.append(f"| `{repo}` | {count} |")
254            lines.append("")
255
256        if self.orchestration_counts:
257            lines.extend([
258                "## Human Orchestration & Operator Friction Tracking",
259                "| Orchestration Action | Count |",
260                "| --- | --- |",
261            ])
262            for act, count in sorted(self.orchestration_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
263                lines.append(f"| `{act}` | {count} |")
264            lines.append("")
265
266        if self.common_failure_modes:
267            lines.append("## Most Common Failure Modes Caught")
268            for fail_mode, count in sorted(self.common_failure_modes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
269                lines.append(f"- **{fail_mode}**: {count} occurrence(s)")
270            lines.append("")
271
272        return "\n".join(lines)

213        for rid, rsum in sorted(self.reviewer_summaries.items()):
214            lines.append(
215                f"| `{rid}` | {rsum.reviewer_runs} | {rsum.findings_total} | {rsum.confirmed_findings} | "
216                f"{rsum.likely_findings} | {rsum.false_positives} | {rsum.disputed_findings} | {rsum.blockers_found} | "
217                f"{rsum.unique_findings} | {rsum.findings_that_triggered_remediation} | {rsum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion} | {rsum.marginal_value} |"
218            )
219        lines.append("")
220
221        if (
222            self.slop_checks_run > 0
223            or self.duplication_regressions_caught > 0
224            or self.debt_acceptance_requests > 0
225            or self.slop_findings_remediated > 0
226            or self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered > 0
227            or self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts > 0
228        ):
229            lines.extend([
230                "## Repository Hygiene & Slop Gate Tracking",
231                f"- **Hygiene checks executed:** {self.slop_checks_run} ({self.slop_checks_failed} failed)",
232                f"- **Duplication regressions caught:** {self.duplication_regressions_caught}",
233                f"- **Ceilings lowered (debt reduced):** {self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered}",
234                f"- **Ceiling raise attempts blocked:** {self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts}",
235                f"- **Policy tightenings:** {self.hygiene_policies_tightened}, **Weakenings requested:** {self.hygiene_policies_weakened}",
236                f"- **Tombstones added (debt accepted):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_added}, **Removed (cleaned):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_removed}",
237                f"- **Orphan surfaces caught:** {self.orphans_caught}",
238                f"- **Stale tombstones caught:** {self.stale_tombstones_caught}",
239                f"- **Contract / claims gaps caught:** {self.claim_gaps_caught}",
240                f"- **Provider integrity mismatches:** {self.hygiene_provider_mismatches}",
241                f"- **Slop findings remediated:** {self.slop_findings_remediated}",
242                f"- **Debt acceptance requests:** {self.debt_acceptance_requests} ({self.debt_acceptance_approved} approved, {self.debt_acceptance_rejected} rejected)",
243                "",
244            ])
245
246        if self.repositories_exercised:
247            lines.extend([
248                "## Repositories Exercised Breakdown",
249                "| Repository | Tasks Recorded |",
250                "| --- | --- |",
251            ])
252            for repo, count in sorted(self.repositories_exercised.items()):
253                lines.append(f"| `{repo}` | {count} |")
254            lines.append("")
255
256        if self.orchestration_counts:
257            lines.extend([
258                "## Human Orchestration & Operator Friction Tracking",
259                "| Orchestration Action | Count |",
260                "| --- | --- |",
261            ])
262            for act, count in sorted(self.orchestration_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
263                lines.append(f"| `{act}` | {count} |")
264            lines.append("")
265
266        if self.common_failure_modes:
267            lines.append("## Most Common Failure Modes Caught")
268            for fail_mode, count in sorted(self.common_failure_modes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
269                lines.append(f"- **{fail_mode}**: {count} occurrence(s)")
270            lines.append("")
271
272        return "\n".join(lines)

Renders the metrics summary in standard operational format.

275class MetricsCalculator:
276    """Calculates verifiable performance statistics from evidence ledger entries."""

278    @staticmethod
279    def calculate(entries: List[EvidenceEntry]) -> PerformanceMetricsSummary:
280        """
281        Parses evidence ledger entries and constructs a PerformanceMetricsSummary
282        with strict first_pass_success semantics.
283        Independent properties are processed independently without mutually exclusive suppression.
284        """
285        summary = PerformanceMetricsSummary()
286        if not entries:
287            return summary
288
289        # Group entries by task
290        tasks: Dict[str, List[EvidenceEntry]] = {}
291        for entry in entries:
292            tasks.setdefault(entry.task_id, []).append(entry)
293
294        summary.total_tasks = len(tasks)
295
296        for task_id, task_entries in tasks.items():
297            task_agents = set()
298            repo_name = None
299            is_task_override = False
300
301            for e in task_entries:
302                if e.agent_id:
303                    task_agents.add(e.agent_id)
304                if e.implementing_agent:
305                    task_agents.add(e.implementing_agent)
306                if e.actual_agent:
307                    task_agents.add(e.actual_agent)
308                if e.repository:
309                    repo_name = e.repository
310                elif isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "repository" in e.metadata:
311                    repo_name = e.metadata["repository"]
312                if e.is_override is True or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("is_override") is True):
313                    is_task_override = True
314
315            if repo_name:
316                summary.repositories_exercised[repo_name] = summary.repositories_exercised.get(repo_name, 0) + 1
317
318            if is_task_override:
319                summary.routing_overrides += 1
320            else:
321                summary.routing_recommendations_followed += 1
322
323            for aid in task_agents:
324                if aid not in summary.agent_summaries:
325                    summary.agent_summaries[aid] = AgentMetricSummary(agent_id=aid)
326                summary.agent_summaries[aid].tasks_worked += 1
327
328            # Task level tracking flags
329            has_remediation = False
330            has_verif_failure = False
331            has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = False
332            has_human_intervention = False
333            is_completed = False
334            is_abandoned = False
335            task_defects_caught = 0
336            task_remediation_cycles = 0
337
338            for e in task_entries:
339                aid = e.actual_agent or e.implementing_agent or e.agent_id
340                agent_sum = summary.agent_summaries.get(aid)
341
342                # 1. Track task class
343                if e.task_class and agent_sum:
344                    agent_sum.task_classes_worked[e.task_class] = (
345                        agent_sum.task_classes_worked.get(e.task_class, 0) + 1
346                    )
347
348                # 2. Track orchestration action
349                orch_act = e.orchestration_action or (e.metadata.get("orchestration_action") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None)
350                if orch_act:
351                    summary.orchestration_counts[orch_act] = summary.orchestration_counts.get(orch_act, 0) + 1
352
353                # 3. Track defect types
354                if e.defect_type == "review_caught_defect" or (e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and (e.metadata.get("reviewer_role") or "review" in e.metadata.get("failure_mode", ""))):
355                    summary.review_caught_defects += 1
356                elif e.defect_type == "verification_caught_defect" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
357                    summary.verification_caught_defects += 1
358                elif e.defect_type == "boundary_caught_risk" or (e.action in ("boundary_checked", "boundary_triggered") and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered")):
359                    summary.boundary_caught_risks += 1
360
361                # 4. Track repository hygiene / slop metrics
362                is_slop_check = e.action == "slop_check_executed" or (
363                    e.action == "verification_executed"
364                    and (
365                        (e.command and "slopslint" in e.command)
366                        or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("category") == "repository_hygiene")
367                    )
368                )
369                if is_slop_check:
370                    summary.slop_checks_run += 1
371                    if e.result == "failed":
372                        summary.slop_checks_failed += 1
373
374                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_requested" or (
375                    e.action in ("boundary_triggered", "boundary_checked")
376                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
377                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered") or [])
378                ):
379                    summary.debt_acceptance_requests += 1
380
381                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_approved" or (
382                    e.action == "human_decision"
383                    and e.result in ("approved", "accepted")
384                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
385                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
386                ):
387                    summary.debt_acceptance_approved += 1
388
389                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_rejected" or (
390                    e.action == "human_decision"
391                    and e.result in ("rejected", "denied")
392                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
393                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
394                ):
395                    summary.debt_acceptance_rejected += 1
396
397                if e.action == "hygiene_policy_tightened":
398                    summary.hygiene_policies_tightened += 1
399
400                if e.action in ("hygiene_policy_weakening_requested", "hygiene_policy_weakened"):
401                    summary.hygiene_policies_weakened += 1
402
403                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_lowered":
404                    summary.hygiene_ceilings_lowered += 1
405
406                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempted":
407                    summary.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts += 1
408
409                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_added":
410                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_added += 1
411
412                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_removed":
413                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_removed += 1
414
415                if e.action == "hygiene_provider_mismatch" or (
416                    isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("failure_mode") == "hygiene_provider_mismatch"
417                ):
418                    summary.hygiene_provider_mismatches += 1
419
420                if e.action == "slop_finding_remediated":
421                    summary.slop_findings_remediated += 1
422
423                # 5. Track control_plane_caught_defect & failure modes
424                if e.control_plane_caught_defect is True or e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
425                    summary.control_plane_caught_defects += 1
426                    task_defects_caught += 1
427                    if agent_sum:
428                        agent_sum.control_plane_defects_caught += 1
429                    if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "failure_mode" in e.metadata:
430                        fmode = e.metadata["failure_mode"]
431                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
432                        if fmode in ("duplication_regression", "ceiling_regression"):
433                            summary.duplication_regressions_caught += 1
434                        elif fmode == "orphan_surface":
435                            summary.orphans_caught += 1
436                        elif fmode == "stale_tombstone":
437                            summary.stale_tombstones_caught += 1
438                        elif fmode == "contract_claim_gap":
439                            summary.claim_gaps_caught += 1
440
441                # 5. Track remediation cycles
442                if e.remediation_cycles and e.remediation_cycles > 0:
443                    has_remediation = True
444                    task_remediation_cycles = max(task_remediation_cycles, e.remediation_cycles)
445
446                if e.action == "remediation_started":
447                    has_remediation = True
448                elif e.action == "remediation_completed":
449                    has_remediation = True
450                    task_remediation_cycles += 1
451                    summary.rework_cycles_total += 1
452                    if agent_sum:
453                        agent_sum.remediation_cycles += 1
454                elif e.action == "reconciliation_completed":
455                    if e.result and "remediated" in e.result.lower():
456                        has_remediation = True
457                        task_remediation_cycles += 1
458
459                # 6. Track reviewer stats & findings
460                if e.action == "review_submitted" or e.reviewing_agents:
461                    reviewers_list = e.reviewing_agents or (
462                        e.metadata.get("reviewers") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None
463                    )
464                    if reviewers_list:
465                        for r_role in reviewers_list:
466                            if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
467                                summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
468                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role].reviewer_runs += 1
469
470                if e.findings_summary:
471                    total_f = e.findings_summary.get("total", 0)
472                    blockers = e.findings_summary.get("blocker", 0)
473                    highs = e.findings_summary.get("high", 0)
474                    confirmed = e.findings_summary.get("confirmed", 0)
475
476                    summary.total_review_findings += total_f
477                    summary.blocker_findings += blockers
478                    summary.high_findings += highs
479                    summary.confirmed_review_findings += confirmed
480
481                    if agent_sum:
482                        agent_sum.review_findings_received += total_f
483                        agent_sum.confirmed_findings_received += confirmed
484                        agent_sum.blocker_findings_received += blockers
485
486                    if blockers > 0 or highs > 0:
487                        has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = True
488
489                if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "reviewers_breakdown" in e.metadata:
490                    rb = e.metadata["reviewers_breakdown"]
491                    for r_role, r_stats in rb.items():
492                        if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
493                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
494                        r_sum = summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role]
495                        r_sum.findings_total += r_stats.get("findings_total", 0)
496                        r_sum.confirmed_findings += r_stats.get("confirmed", 0)
497                        r_sum.likely_findings += r_stats.get("likely", 0)
498                        r_sum.false_positives += r_stats.get("false_positives", 0)
499                        r_sum.disputed_findings += r_stats.get("disputed", 0)
500                        r_sum.blockers_found += r_stats.get("blockers", 0)
501                        r_sum.high_findings_found += r_stats.get("highs", 0)
502                        r_sum.unique_findings += r_stats.get("unique", 0)
503                        r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation += r_stats.get("triggered_remediation", 0)
504                        r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion += r_stats.get("prevented_bad_completion", 0)
505
506                # 7. Track verification
507                if e.action == "verification_executed":
508                    if e.result == "failed":
509                        has_verif_failure = True
510                        summary.verification_failures += 1
511                        if agent_sum:
512                            agent_sum.verification_failures += 1
513                        fmode = "verification_failure"
514                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
515
516                # 8. Track human decision
517                if e.action == "human_decision" or e.human_decision is not None:
518                    has_human_intervention = True
519                    summary.human_interventions += 1
520                    if agent_sum:
521                        agent_sum.human_interventions += 1
522
523                # 9. Track task closed
524                if e.action == "task_closed":
525                    if e.result == "complete":
526                        is_completed = True
527                        if agent_sum:
528                            agent_sum.tasks_completed += 1
529                    elif e.result in ("failed", "abandoned"):
530                        is_abandoned = True
531                        if agent_sum:
532                            agent_sum.tasks_abandoned += 1
533
534            if has_remediation:
535                summary.tasks_requiring_remediation += 1
536
537            if is_completed:
538                summary.completed_tasks += 1
539                is_first_pass = (
540                    not has_remediation
541                    and not has_verif_failure
542                    and not has_confirmed_blocker_or_high
543                    and not has_human_intervention
544                    and task_remediation_cycles == 0
545                )
546                if is_first_pass:
547                    summary.first_pass_successes += 1
548                    for aid in task_agents:
549                        if aid in summary.agent_summaries:
550                            summary.agent_summaries[aid].first_pass_successes += 1
551            elif is_abandoned:
552                summary.abandoned_tasks += 1
553
554        # Compute marginal value for each reviewer
555        for r_role, r_sum in summary.reviewer_summaries.items():
556            r_sum.marginal_value = (
557                r_sum.unique_findings
558                + r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation
559                + r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion
560                + r_sum.blockers_found
561            )
562
563        return summary

460                if e.action == "review_submitted" or e.reviewing_agents:
461                    reviewers_list = e.reviewing_agents or (
462                        e.metadata.get("reviewers") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None
463                    )
464                    if reviewers_list:
465                        for r_role in reviewers_list:
466                            if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
467                                summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
468                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role].reviewer_runs += 1
469
470                if e.findings_summary:
471                    total_f = e.findings_summary.get("total", 0)
472                    blockers = e.findings_summary.get("blocker", 0)
473                    highs = e.findings_summary.get("high", 0)
474                    confirmed = e.findings_summary.get("confirmed", 0)
475
476                    summary.total_review_findings += total_f
477                    summary.blocker_findings += blockers
478                    summary.high_findings += highs
479                    summary.confirmed_review_findings += confirmed
480
481                    if agent_sum:
482                        agent_sum.review_findings_received += total_f
483                        agent_sum.confirmed_findings_received += confirmed
484                        agent_sum.blocker_findings_received += blockers
485
486                    if blockers > 0 or highs > 0:
487                        has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = True
488
489                if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "reviewers_breakdown" in e.metadata:
490                    rb = e.metadata["reviewers_breakdown"]
491                    for r_role, r_stats in rb.items():
492                        if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
493                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
494                        r_sum = summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role]
495                        r_sum.findings_total += r_stats.get("findings_total", 0)
496                        r_sum.confirmed_findings += r_stats.get("confirmed", 0)
497                        r_sum.likely_findings += r_stats.get("likely", 0)
498                        r_sum.false_positives += r_stats.get("false_positives", 0)
499                        r_sum.disputed_findings += r_stats.get("disputed", 0)
500                        r_sum.blockers_found += r_stats.get("blockers", 0)
501                        r_sum.high_findings_found += r_stats.get("highs", 0)
502                        r_sum.unique_findings += r_stats.get("unique", 0)
503                        r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation += r_stats.get("triggered_remediation", 0)
504                        r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion += r_stats.get("prevented_bad_completion", 0)
505
506                # 7. Track verification
507                if e.action == "verification_executed":
508                    if e.result == "failed":
509                        has_verif_failure = True
510                        summary.verification_failures += 1
511                        if agent_sum:
512                            agent_sum.verification_failures += 1
513                        fmode = "verification_failure"
514                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
515
516                # 8. Track human decision
517                if e.action == "human_decision" or e.human_decision is not None:
518                    has_human_intervention = True
519                    summary.human_interventions += 1
520                    if agent_sum:
521                        agent_sum.human_interventions += 1
522
523                # 9. Track task closed
524                if e.action == "task_closed":
525                    if e.result == "complete":
526                        is_completed = True
527                        if agent_sum:
528                            agent_sum.tasks_completed += 1
529                    elif e.result in ("failed", "abandoned"):
530                        is_abandoned = True
531                        if agent_sum:
532                            agent_sum.tasks_abandoned += 1
533
534            if has_remediation:
535                summary.tasks_requiring_remediation += 1
536
537            if is_completed:
538                summary.completed_tasks += 1
539                is_first_pass = (
540                    not has_remediation
541                    and not has_verif_failure
542                    and not has_confirmed_blocker_or_high
543                    and not has_human_intervention
544                    and task_remediation_cycles == 0
545                )
546                if is_first_pass:
547                    summary.first_pass_successes += 1
548                    for aid in task_agents:
549                        if aid in summary.agent_summaries:
550                            summary.agent_summaries[aid].first_pass_successes += 1
551            elif is_abandoned:
552                summary.abandoned_tasks += 1
553
554        # Compute marginal value for each reviewer
555        for r_role, r_sum in summary.reviewer_summaries.items():
556            r_sum.marginal_value = (
557                r_sum.unique_findings
558                + r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation
559                + r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion
560                + r_sum.blockers_found
561            )
562
563        return summary

Parses evidence ledger entries and constructs a PerformanceMetricsSummary with strict first_pass_success semantics. Independent properties are processed independently without mutually exclusive suppression.

 95class ProjectAdapter:
 96    """
 97    Discovers project configuration and constructs project-specific verification plans
 98    while respecting local project sovereignty.
 99    """
100
101    @classmethod
102    def discover(cls, project_dir: Union[str, Path] = ".") -> ProjectContext:
103        """
104        Scans a directory for .ai-project.toml, project_manifest.yaml, .slop/ configuration,
105        or project stack markers.
106        """
107        root = Path(project_dir).resolve()
108        name = root.name
109        project_types: List[str] = []
110        skills: List[str] = []
111        test_commands: List[List[str]] = []
112        build_commands: List[List[str]] = []
113        lint_commands: List[List[str]] = []
114        hygiene_commands: List[List[str]] = []
115        hygiene_status = "not_configured"
116        capabilities: List[str] = []
117        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}
118        has_manifest = False
119        has_agents_md = (root / "AGENTS.md").exists()
120
121        def _extract_manifest_cmds(cmds: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
122            for k in ("test", "build", "lint"):
123                if k in cmds:
124                    val = cmds[k]
125                    cmd_list = val if isinstance(val, list) else [val]
126                    if k == "test":
127                        test_commands.append(cmd_list)
128                    elif k == "build":
129                        build_commands.append(cmd_list)
130                    elif k == "lint":
131                        lint_commands.append(cmd_list)
132            for hk in ("hygiene", "repository_hygiene"):
133                if hk in cmds:
134                    hval = cmds[hk]
135                    hygiene_commands.append(hval if isinstance(hval, list) else [hval])
136                    break
137
138        # 1. Check for .ai-project.toml
139        ai_toml = root / ".ai-project.toml"
140        if ai_toml.exists():
141            has_manifest = True
142            with open(ai_toml, "rb") as f:
143                data = tomllib.load(f)
144            name = data.get("name", name)
145            project_types = data.get("project_type", [])
146            skills = data.get("skills", [])
147            _extract_manifest_cmds(data.get("commands", {}))
148            sec = data.get("security", {})
149            capabilities = sec.get("capabilities", [])
150            metadata.update(data.get("metadata", {}))
151
152        # 2. Check for project_manifest.yaml
153        manifest_yaml = root / "project_manifest.yaml"
154        if manifest_yaml.exists() and not has_manifest:
155            has_manifest = True
156            with open(manifest_yaml, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
157                data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
158            name = data.get("name", name)
159            project_types = data.get("project_types", [])
160            skills = data.get("skills", [])
161            _extract_manifest_cmds(data.get("commands", {}))
162            capabilities = data.get("capabilities", [])
163            metadata.update(data.get("metadata", {}))
164
165        # 3. Discover SlopsLint repository hygiene configuration
166        slop_config = root / ".slop" / "config.yml"
167        slop_ceilings = root / ".slop" / "ceilings.yml"
168        if slop_config.exists():
169            if not slop_ceilings.exists():
170                hygiene_status = "invalid_configuration"
171            else:
172                ok, _, pmeta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity("slopslint")
173                if ok:
174                    hygiene_status = "configured_and_passed"
175                elif pmeta.get("status") == "version_mismatch":
176                    hygiene_status = "invalid_provider_version"
177                else:
178                    hygiene_status = "configured_tool_missing"
179
180            if not hygiene_commands:
181                hygiene_commands.append(["slopslint", "check", "--classify", "--enforce"])
182
183        # 4. Discover HowlFrame source files and metadata
184        howl_sources = _find_howl_sources(root)
185        if howl_sources:
186            if "howlframe" not in project_types:
187                project_types.append("howlframe")
188            if "howlframe-app-development" not in skills:
189                skills.append("howlframe-app-development")
190            metadata["howl_sources"] = [str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in howl_sources]
191            metadata["howl_source_count"] = len(howl_sources)
192            apparent_targets = _extract_apparent_targets(howl_sources)
193            if apparent_targets:
194                metadata["apparent_targets"] = apparent_targets
195
196        if "howlframe" in project_types and "howlframe-app-development" not in skills:
197            skills.append("howlframe-app-development")
198
199        # Check for HowlFrame bootstrap revision in scripts/bootstrap.sh
200        bootstrap_sh = root / "scripts" / "bootstrap.sh"
201        if bootstrap_sh.is_file():
202            try:
203                boot_txt = bootstrap_sh.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
204                rev_match = re.search(r'PINNED_HOWLFRAME_REV\s*=\s*["\']?([a-f0-9]+)["\']?', boot_txt)
205                if rev_match:
206                    metadata["howlframe_pinned_rev"] = rev_match.group(1)
207            except Exception:
208                pass
209
210        # Check for nested Go module (e.g. tests/go.mod)
211        tests_go_mod = root / "tests" / "go.mod"
212        if tests_go_mod.is_file():
213            metadata.setdefault("nested_modules", []).append({"type": "go", "path": "tests"})
214            metadata["test_module"] = "tests/go.mod"
215
216        # 5. Stack heuristics if commands are not explicitly specified
217        if not test_commands or not build_commands or not lint_commands:
218            # Check for Makefile
219            makefile = root / "Makefile"
220            if makefile.exists():
221                text = makefile.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
222                if "test:" in text and not test_commands:
223                    test_commands.append(["make", "test"])
224                if "lint:" in text and not lint_commands:
225                    lint_commands.append(["make", "lint"])
226                if "build:" in text and not build_commands:
227                    build_commands.append(["make", "build"])
228
229            # Check for Go (root module)
230            if (root / "go.mod").exists():
231                if "go" not in project_types:
232                    project_types.append("go")
233                if not test_commands:
234                    test_commands.append(["go", "test", "./..."])
235                if not build_commands:
236                    build_commands.append(["go", "build", "./..."])
237                if not lint_commands:
238                    lint_commands.append(["go", "vet", "./..."])
239
240            # Check for Python
241            if (root / "pyproject.toml").exists() or (root / "setup.py").exists() or (root / "requirements.txt").exists():
242                if "python" not in project_types:
243                    project_types.append("python")
244                if not test_commands:
245                    test_commands.append(["pytest"])
246                if not lint_commands:
247                    lint_commands.append(["flake8"])
248
249            # Check for Node / TS
250            if (root / "package.json").exists():
251                if "javascript" not in project_types:
252                    project_types.append("javascript")
253                if not test_commands:
254                    test_commands.append(["npm", "test"])
255
256            # Check for Rust
257            if (root / "Cargo.toml").exists():
258                if "rust" not in project_types:
259                    project_types.append("rust")
260                if not test_commands:
261                    test_commands.append(["cargo", "test"])
262                if not build_commands:
263                    build_commands.append(["cargo", "build"])
264
265            # Check for conventional script entrypoints in scripts/
266            if not build_commands:
267                if (root / "scripts" / "build.sh").is_file():
268                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build.sh"])
269                elif (root / "scripts" / "build").is_file():
270                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build"])
271
272            if not test_commands:
273                if (root / "scripts" / "test.sh").is_file():
274                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test.sh"])
275                elif (root / "scripts" / "test").is_file():
276                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test"])
277
278            if not lint_commands:
279                if (root / "scripts" / "lint.sh").is_file():
280                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint.sh"])
281                elif (root / "scripts" / "lint").is_file():
282                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint"])
283
284            # Check for nested test module fallback if test_commands still empty
285            if not test_commands and tests_go_mod.is_file():
286                test_commands.append(["bash", "-c", "cd tests && go test ./..."])
287
288            # Check for standalone shell test suites
289            tests_dir = root / "tests"
290            if tests_dir.is_dir() and not test_commands:
291                sh_tests = sorted(tests_dir.glob("*.sh"))
292                for sh_t in sh_tests:
293                    rel_p = str(sh_t.relative_to(root))
294                    test_commands.append(["bash", rel_p])
295
296        return ProjectContext(
297            project_root=str(root),
298            name=name,
299            project_types=project_types,
300            skills=skills,
301            test_commands=test_commands,
302            build_commands=build_commands,
303            lint_commands=lint_commands,
304            hygiene_commands=hygiene_commands,
305            hygiene_status=hygiene_status,
306            capabilities=capabilities,
307            has_manifest=has_manifest,
308            has_agents_md=has_agents_md,
309            metadata=metadata,
310        )
311
312    @classmethod
313    def create_verification_plan(cls, context: ProjectContext, task_id: str) -> VerificationPlan:
314        """
315        Creates a VerificationPlan tailored to the project's discovered commands.
316        """
317        plan = VerificationPlan(task_id=task_id)
318        idx = 1
319
320        for cmd in context.lint_commands:
321            plan.add_step(
322                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
323                name=f"Lint check ({' '.join(cmd)})",
324                command=cmd,
325                category="lint",
326                required=True,
327            )
328            idx += 1
329
330        for cmd in context.build_commands:
331            plan.add_step(
332                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
333                name=f"Build check ({' '.join(cmd)})",
334                command=cmd,
335                category="build",
336                required=True,
337            )
338            idx += 1
339
340        for cmd in context.test_commands:
341            plan.add_step(
342                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
343                name=f"Automated test suite ({' '.join(cmd)})",
344                command=cmd,
345                category="unit_test",
346                required=True,
347            )
348            idx += 1
349
350        for cmd in context.hygiene_commands:
351            plan.add_step(
352                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
353                name=f"Repository hygiene gate ({' '.join(cmd)})",
354                command=cmd,
355                category="repository_hygiene",
356                required=True,
357            )
358            idx += 1
359
360        return plan

Discovers project configuration and constructs project-specific verification plans while respecting local project sovereignty.

268                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build.sh"])
269                elif (root / "scripts" / "build").is_file():
270                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build"])
271
272            if not test_commands:
273                if (root / "scripts" / "test.sh").is_file():
274                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test.sh"])
275                elif (root / "scripts" / "test").is_file():
276                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test"])
277
278            if not lint_commands:
279                if (root / "scripts" / "lint.sh").is_file():
280                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint.sh"])
281                elif (root / "scripts" / "lint").is_file():
282                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint"])
283
284            # Check for nested test module fallback if test_commands still empty
285            if not test_commands and tests_go_mod.is_file():
286                test_commands.append(["bash", "-c", "cd tests && go test ./..."])
287
288            # Check for standalone shell test suites
289            tests_dir = root / "tests"
290            if tests_dir.is_dir() and not test_commands:
291                sh_tests = sorted(tests_dir.glob("*.sh"))
292                for sh_t in sh_tests:
293                    rel_p = str(sh_t.relative_to(root))
294                    test_commands.append(["bash", rel_p])
295
296        return ProjectContext(
297            project_root=str(root),
298            name=name,
299            project_types=project_types,
300            skills=skills,
301            test_commands=test_commands,
302            build_commands=build_commands,
303            lint_commands=lint_commands,
304            hygiene_commands=hygiene_commands,
305            hygiene_status=hygiene_status,
306            capabilities=capabilities,
307            has_manifest=has_manifest,
308            has_agents_md=has_agents_md,
309            metadata=metadata,
310        )

Scans a directory for .ai-project.toml, project_manifest.yaml, .slop/ configuration, or project stack markers.

@classmethod
def create_verification_plan( cls, context: ProjectContext, task_id: str) -> VerificationPlan: 
312    @classmethod
313    def create_verification_plan(cls, context: ProjectContext, task_id: str) -> VerificationPlan:
314        """
315        Creates a VerificationPlan tailored to the project's discovered commands.
316        """
317        plan = VerificationPlan(task_id=task_id)
318        idx = 1
319
320        for cmd in context.lint_commands:
321            plan.add_step(
322                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
323                name=f"Lint check ({' '.join(cmd)})",
324                command=cmd,
325                category="lint",
326                required=True,
327            )
328            idx += 1
329
330        for cmd in context.build_commands:
331            plan.add_step(
332                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
333                name=f"Build check ({' '.join(cmd)})",
334                command=cmd,
335                category="build",
336                required=True,
337            )
338            idx += 1
339
340        for cmd in context.test_commands:
341            plan.add_step(
342                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
343                name=f"Automated test suite ({' '.join(cmd)})",
344                command=cmd,
345                category="unit_test",
346                required=True,
347            )
348            idx += 1
349
350        for cmd in context.hygiene_commands:
351            plan.add_step(
352                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
353                name=f"Repository hygiene gate ({' '.join(cmd)})",
354                command=cmd,
355                category="repository_hygiene",
356                required=True,
357            )
358            idx += 1
359
360        return plan

Creates a VerificationPlan tailored to the project's discovered commands.

class HumanBoundaryGate: 
223class HumanBoundaryGate:
224    """Evaluates task intent, actions, and risk against human authority policies."""
225
226    @classmethod
227    def _build_pre_execution_packet(
228        cls,
229        task: TaskSpec,
230        triggers: List[str],
231        actions: List[ProposedAction],
232        change_summary: str,
233        evidence: List[str],
234        risk_prefix: str = "Pre-execution boundary",
235    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
236        """
237        Shared decision-packet construction for the pre-implementation
238        boundary paths (evaluate_pre_execution and the non-delegated
239        fallback of evaluate_with_delegated_authority), which otherwise
240        differ only in change_summary/evidence text.
241        """
242        risks = [f"{risk_prefix} '{t}': {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}" for t in triggers]
243        packet = HumanDecisionPacket(
244            task_id=task.task_id,
245            objective=task.objective,
246            change_summary=change_summary,
247            boundary_triggers=triggers,
248            evidence=evidence,
249            risks=risks,
250            review_findings_summary={"total": 0, "blocker": 0, "high": 0},
251            verification_status="pre_execution",
252            recommended_action="Review requested consequential action and authorize or reject execution.",
253            proposed_actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
254            executor_id=actions[0].executor_id if actions and actions[0].executor_id else None,
255        )
256        return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=True, triggered_boundaries=triggers, decision_packet=packet)
257
258    @classmethod
259    def evaluate_pre_execution(
260        cls,
261        task: TaskSpec,
262        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
263        target_repo: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
264    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
265        """
266        Evaluates task objective, metadata, and planned actions BEFORE launching an implementation agent.
267        Prevents unrestricted agents from executing consequential mutations prior to human authority.
268        """
269        repo_name = task.repository or (Path(target_repo).name if target_repo else "")
270        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
271            objective=task.objective,
272            repo_name=repo_name,
273            planned_actions=planned_actions,
274            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
275        )
276
277        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
278        if task.human_approval_requirements:
279            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
280                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
281                    triggers.append(req)
282
283        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
284            triggers.append("production_deployment")
285
286        if not triggers:
287            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
288
289        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
290            task, triggers, actions,
291            change_summary="Consequential action requested prior to implementation agent launch.",
292            evidence=["Pre-execution authority evaluation"],
293        )
294
295    @classmethod
296    def evaluate(
297        cls,
298        task: TaskSpec,
299        planned_actions: List[str],
300        change_summary: str = "",
301        reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None,
302        verification: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
303        hygiene_policy: Optional[PolicyEvaluationResult] = None,
304    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
305        """
306        Determines whether the post-verification task hits a human authority boundary.
307        Distinguishes quality improvements (autonomously permitted) from debt acceptance / weakening.
308        """
309        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
310            objective=task.objective,
311            repo_name=task.repository,
312            planned_actions=planned_actions,
313            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
314        )
315        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
316
317        if task.human_approval_requirements:
318            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
319                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
320                    triggers.append(req)
321
322        if hygiene_policy:
323            if hygiene_policy.is_hard_rejected and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
324                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
325            if hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.DEBT_ACCEPTANCE and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
326                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
327            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.WEAKENING and "hygiene_policy_weakening" not in triggers:
328                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_weakening")
329            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.UNKNOWN and "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
330                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
331        else:
332            actions_str = " ".join(planned_actions).lower()
333            if "tombstone" in actions_str and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
334                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
335            if "ceiling increase" in actions_str and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
336                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
337
338        # 4. Inspect reconciliation findings for unresolved blockers or security human reviews
339        if reconciliation and reconciliation.requires_human_judgment:
340            if "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
341                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
342
343        # 5. Critical risk tasks always trigger human authority
344        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
345            triggers.append("production_deployment")
346
347        if not triggers:
348            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
349
350        # Build decision packet
351        evidence_list: List[str] = []
352        if verification:
353            for step in verification.steps:
354                evidence_list.append(f"Step '{step.name}': {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
355
356        if hygiene_policy and hygiene_policy.changes:
357            for c in hygiene_policy.changes:
358                evidence_list.append(f"Policy Change [{c.change_type.value.upper()}]: {c.description}")
359
360        risks_list: List[str] = []
361        for t in triggers:
362            risks_list.append(f"Policy boundary '{t}': {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}")
363
364        findings_summary = {
365            "total": len(reconciliation.findings) if reconciliation else 0,
366            "blocker": reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if reconciliation else 0,
367            "high": reconciliation.unresolved_highs if reconciliation else 0,
368        }
369
370        rec_action = "Review diff and evidence packet, then provide explicit approval or rejection."
371        if "hygiene_policy_violation" in triggers:
372            rec_action = "HARD REJECT: Prohibited ceiling inflation or policy violation must be remediated in code."
373
374        summary_text = change_summary
375        if not summary_text and hygiene_policy:
376            summary_text = hygiene_policy.summary
377        if not summary_text:
378            summary_text = "Pending review & human confirmation."
379
380        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
381            objective=task.objective,
382            repo_name=task.repository,
383            planned_actions=planned_actions,
384            human_approval_requirements=triggers,
385        )
386        executor_id = actions[0].executor_id if actions and actions[0].executor_id else None
387
388        packet = HumanDecisionPacket(
389            task_id=task.task_id,
390            objective=task.objective,
391            change_summary=summary_text,
392            boundary_triggers=triggers,
393            evidence=evidence_list,
394            risks=risks_list,
395            review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
396            verification_status=verification.overall_status if verification else "unverified",
397            recommended_action=rec_action,
398            proposed_actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
399            executor_id=executor_id,
400        )
401
402        return BoundaryCheckResult(
403            requires_human_approval=True,
404            triggered_boundaries=triggers,
405            decision_packet=packet,
406        )
407
408    @classmethod
409    def evaluate_with_delegated_authority(
410        cls,
411        task: TaskSpec,
412        planned_actions: List[str],
413        envelope: Optional[Any] = None,
414        target_repo: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
415        repo_slug: Optional[str] = None,
416        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
417        **kwargs: Any,
418    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
419        """
420        Delegated-authority pre-check (#59 Phase 11): ProposedAction ->
421        identify authority class -> does the campaign's AuthorityEnvelope
422        contain exact permission? If every triggered boundary resolves to
423        DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW, autonomous continuation is permitted
424        without asking a human. Otherwise this falls through to today's
425        evaluate_pre_execution()/evaluate() behavior unchanged -- this
426        method never weakens or replaces existing human-boundary protection,
427        it only adds a policy-driven allow path in front of it.
428
429        The model never answers "am I allowed?" here: the only inputs that
430        matter are the envelope (operator-created, tamper-verified) and the
431        NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES set (code-defined, not campaign data).
432        """
433        # Local imports to avoid a hard import-time dependency from
434        # human_boundary.py (a foundational, widely-imported module) on the
435        # newer authority modules, and to keep this delegated-authority path
436        # entirely optional for callers that don't pass an envelope.
437        from src.control_plane.authority_envelope import (
438            AuthorityDecision,
439            evaluate_action_against_envelope,
440        )
441        from src.control_plane.proposed_action import infer_proposed_actions_from_diff
442
443        repo_name = task.repository or (Path(target_repo).name if target_repo else "")
444        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
445            objective=task.objective,
446            repo_name=repo_name,
447            planned_actions=planned_actions,
448            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
449        )
450        actions = actions + infer_proposed_actions_from_diff(files_changed or [], repo_name=repo_name)
451
452        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
453        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
454            triggers.append("production_deployment")
455
456        if not triggers:
457            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
458
459        slug = repo_slug or repo_name
460        all_delegated = True
461        reasons: List[str] = []
462        for trigger in triggers:
463            if trigger in NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES:
464                all_delegated = False
465                reasons.append(f"'{trigger}' is never delegatable regardless of envelope contents.")
466                continue
467            decision, reason = evaluate_action_against_envelope(envelope, trigger, slug)
468            if decision != AuthorityDecision.DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW:
469                all_delegated = False
470            reasons.append(reason)
471
472        if all_delegated:
473            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False, triggered_boundaries=triggers)
474
475        # Not fully delegated: build the human decision packet directly from
476        # the triggers already computed above (which may include diff-based
477        # self-modification triggers that evaluate_pre_execution()'s own
478        # text-only inference would never see) rather than re-deriving
479        # triggers from scratch and silently losing them.
480        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
481            task, triggers, actions,
482            change_summary="Consequential action requested; delegated authority did not fully cover it.",
483            evidence=["Delegated authority evaluation: " + "; ".join(reasons)],
484            risk_prefix="Boundary",
485        )

Evaluates task intent, actions, and risk against human authority policies.

473            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False, triggered_boundaries=triggers)
474
475        # Not fully delegated: build the human decision packet directly from
476        # the triggers already computed above (which may include diff-based
477        # self-modification triggers that evaluate_pre_execution()'s own
478        # text-only inference would never see) rather than re-deriving
479        # triggers from scratch and silently losing them.
480        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
481            task, triggers, actions,
482            change_summary="Consequential action requested; delegated authority did not fully cover it.",
483            evidence=["Delegated authority evaluation: " + "; ".join(reasons)],
484            risk_prefix="Boundary",
485        )

Delegated-authority pre-check (#59 Phase 11): ProposedAction -> identify authority class -> does the campaign's AuthorityEnvelope contain exact permission? If every triggered boundary resolves to DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW, autonomous continuation is permitted without asking a human. Otherwise this falls through to today's evaluate_pre_execution()/evaluate() behavior unchanged -- this method never weakens or replaces existing human-boundary protection, it only adds a policy-driven allow path in front of it.

The model never answers "am I allowed?" here: the only inputs that matter are the envelope (operator-created, tamper-verified) and the NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES set (code-defined, not campaign data).
