class GovernedTaskOrchestrator: 
 234class GovernedTaskOrchestrator:
 235    """
 236    Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining
 237    strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews,
 238    remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
 239    """
 240
 241    def __init__(
 242        self,
 243        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 244        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 245        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
 246    ):
 247        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 248        self.control_plane_root = (
 249            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
 250            if control_plane_root
 251            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
 252        )
 253        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
 254        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
 255        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
 256        traj_dir = self.config.trajectory_store_dir
 257        if traj_dir is None:
 258            traj_dir = self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "trajectories"
 259        self.trajectory_store = TrajectoryStore(traj_dir) if self.config.record_trajectory else None
 260
 261    def _enforce_task_path_scope(self, task_spec: TaskSpec, delta: RepositoryDelta) -> List[str]:
 262        """
 263        Reverts edits outside `task_spec.allowed_paths` before the delta is
 264        reviewed (#59.2 Phase 8/17).
 265
 266        `allowed_paths` was previously enforced only at commit time, inside
 267        GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit -- after independent review had
 268        already seen (and legitimately objected to) the out-of-scope work. A
 269        path-scoped task whose agent wandered into production files therefore
 270        parked on review findings about code it was never permitted to change.
 271        Enforcing here keeps the reviewed diff identical to the committed one.
 272
 273        Reverts only the paths the delta itself names, using the same
 274        `git checkout --` / unlink pair as _reconcile_attempt_state: no
 275        `git reset --hard`, no `git clean`, and files the task never touched
 276        are never inspected. Returns the reverted paths (empty when the task
 277        declares no scope, which is the default for ordinary tasks).
 278        """
 279        allowed = list(task_spec.allowed_paths or [])
 280        if not allowed or delta is None or delta.is_empty:
 281            return []
 282
 283        repo_root = Path(self.target_repo).resolve()
 284        out_of_scope = [
 285            p for p in (
 286                list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted) + list(delta.files_added)
 287            )
 288            if p not in allowed
 289        ]
 290        added = set(delta.files_added)
 291        for rel_path in out_of_scope:
 292            if rel_path in added:
 293                candidate = (repo_root / rel_path).resolve()
 294                # Never step outside the repository, whatever the delta claims.
 295                if not str(candidate).startswith(str(repo_root)):
 296                    continue
 297                try:
 298                    if candidate.is_file():
 299                        candidate.unlink()
 300                except OSError:
 301                    pass
 302            else:
 303                run_git(repo_root, ["checkout", "--", rel_path], 30)
 304        return out_of_scope
 305
 306    def _capture_scoped_delta(
 307        self,
 308        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 309        baseline: GitBaseline,
 310        agent_id: str,
 311        stage: str,
 312    ) -> RepositoryDelta:
 313        """Capture delta and revert any out-of-scope edits before review/commit."""
 314        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 315        reverted_scope = self._enforce_task_path_scope(task_spec, delta)
 316        if reverted_scope:
 317            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 318            self._record_event(
 319                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 320                agent_id=agent_id,
 321                action="out_of_scope_edits_reverted",
 322                spec=task_spec,
 323                metadata={"reverted_paths": reverted_scope, "allowed_paths": list(task_spec.allowed_paths), "stage": stage},
 324            )
 325        return delta
 326
 327    def _record_implementation_attempt(
 328        self,
 329        run_dir: Path,
 330        attempts_dir: Path,
 331        attempt_num: int,
 332        resource_id: str,
 333        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult],
 334        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 335        failure_class: Optional[str],
 336        capacity_before: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 337    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 338        """Persists attempt-level evidence and returns an additive record."""
 339        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 340        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 341
 342        if impl_res is not None:
 343            (attempt_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 344        (attempt_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 345        if not delta.is_empty:
 346            (attempt_dir / "partial_work.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 347
 348        capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = {}
 349        if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
 350            # record_result already mutated state; capture after.
 351            capacity_after = self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
 352
 353        record: Dict[str, Any] = {
 354            "attempt": attempt_num,
 355            "resource_id": resource_id,
 356            "agent_id": impl_res.agent_id if impl_res else resource_id,
 357            "identity": self._resource_identity_fields(resource_id),
 358            "success": impl_res.success if impl_res else False,
 359            "exit_code": impl_res.exit_code if impl_res else None,
 360            "duration_seconds": impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
 361            "failure_class": failure_class,
 362            "delta": delta.to_dict(),
 363            "capacity_before": capacity_before,
 364            "capacity_after": capacity_after,
 365            "evidence_dir": str(attempt_dir.relative_to(run_dir)),
 366        }
 367        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
 368        return record
 369
 370    def _resource_identity_fields(self, resource_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 371        """Names which provider, interface, and model actually ran this attempt."""
 372        state = (
 373            self.config.provider_pool.get_resource_status(resource_id)
 374            if self.config.provider_pool is not None else None
 375        )
 376        if state is None:
 377            return {
 378                "provider_id": None,
 379                "interface_id": None,
 380                "resource_id": resource_id,
 381                "model_id": None,
 382            }
 383        return {
 384            "provider_id": state.provider_id,
 385            "interface_id": state.interface_id,
 386            "resource_id": state.resource_id or resource_id,
 387            "model_id": state.model_id,
 388        }
 389
 390    @staticmethod
 391    def _persist_attempt_record(
 392        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 393        attempts_dir: Path,
 394    ) -> None:
 395        """Rewrites an attempt's record in place as later evidence is amended.
 396
 397        Attempt evidence is additive and is filled in across the attempt's
 398        lifetime -- the result first, then the failover selection, then the
 399        rollback outcome -- so every amendment goes through here rather than
 400        opening its own write path.
 401        """
 402        record_path = (
 403            attempts_dir
 404            / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{attempt_record['resource_id']}"
 405            / "attempt_record.json"
 406        )
 407        record_path.write_text(json.dumps(attempt_record, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
 408
 409    def _attach_next_selection(
 410        self,
 411        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 412        attempts_dir: Path,
 413        decision: Any,
 414    ) -> None:
 415        """Records which resource failover chose next, and why the others lost."""
 416        selected = getattr(decision, "selected", None)
 417        attempt_record["next_selection"] = {
 418            "selected_resource_id": selected.resource_id if selected else None,
 419            "blocked_reason": getattr(decision, "blocked_reason", None),
 420            "eligible_resources": [
 421                identity.resource_id
 422                for identity in getattr(decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
 423            ],
 424            "exclusions": [
 425                {
 426                    "resource_id": exclusion.resource_id,
 427                    "reason": exclusion.reason,
 428                    "stage": exclusion.stage,
 429                }
 430                for exclusion in getattr(decision, "exclusions", []) or []
 431            ],
 432        }
 433        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 434
 435    def _attach_rollback_result(
 436        self,
 437        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 438        attempts_dir: Path,
 439        restored: bool,
 440        error: Optional[str],
 441    ) -> None:
 442        """Records whether this attempt's work was safely undone before the next."""
 443        attempt_record["rollback"] = {"restored": restored, "error": error}
 444        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 445
 446    def _park_awaiting_human(
 447        self,
 448        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 449        run_dir: Path,
 450        err_msg: str,
 451        decision_pkt: "HumanDecisionPacket",
 452        progress: Any,
 453    ) -> None:
 454        """Hands a task to human authority, leaving the working tree in place.
 455
 456        Every parking path performs the same five steps, and the working tree is
 457        deliberately never rolled back here: a human is being asked to look at
 458        exactly what is on disk.
 459        """
 460        progress.record_terminal(
 461            TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 462            TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 463            error_message=err_msg,
 464        )
 465        task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", err_msg)
 466        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 467        (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
 468            decision_pkt.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
 469        )
 470        self._record_human_boundary_events(task_spec, run_dir, reason=err_msg)
 471
 472    @staticmethod
 473    def _attempt_workspace_hint(task: TaskSpec) -> str:
 474        """The provider-writable scratch path, as named to the provider."""
 475        return (
 476            f".task_runs/{task.task_id}/implementation/attempts/"
 477            "<NN-resource>/workspace/"
 478        )
 479
 480    def _sweep_provider_scratch(
 481        self,
 482        run_dir: Path,
 483        attempt_dir: Path,
 484        resource_id: str,
 485        attempt_num: int,
 486        known_before: Set[str],
 487    ) -> List[str]:
 488        """Moves files a provider left at the evidence root into its workspace.
 489
 490        Providers were never told where scratch belongs, so one wrote
 491        wip-refactor.patch straight into the run's evidence root, blurring which
 492        files the control plane owns (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Anything that
 493        appeared at the root during this attempt is relocated under the
 494        attempt's workspace/ with a provenance note. Nothing is deleted -- the
 495        artifacts may well be useful, they just are not evidence.
 496        """
 497        workspace = attempt_dir / "workspace"
 498        swept: List[str] = []
 499        for entry in sorted(run_dir.iterdir()):
 500            if not entry.is_file() or entry.name in known_before:
 501                continue
 502            workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 503            destination = workspace / entry.name
 504            try:
 505                entry.replace(destination)
 506            except OSError:
 507                continue
 508            swept.append(entry.name)
 509        if swept:
 510            atomic_write_json(
 511                workspace / "_provenance.json",
 512                {
 513                    "origin": "provider_scratch",
 514                    "created_by": resource_id,
 515                    "attempt": attempt_num,
 516                    "relocated_from": f".task_runs/{run_dir.name}/",
 517                    "files": swept,
 518                    "note": (
 519                        "Written by the provider inside the control plane's "
 520                        "evidence namespace and relocated here. Not control "
 521                        "plane evidence."
 522                    ),
 523                    "swept_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 524                    "schema": PROVIDER_SCRATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 525                },
 526            )
 527        return swept
 528
 529    @staticmethod
 530    def _is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
 531        failure_class: Optional[Any],
 532        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta],
 533    ) -> bool:
 534        """Reports whether a budget-stopped attempt left work worth governing.
 535
 536        A provider we stopped at our own deadline never claimed completion, but
 537        that says nothing about what it had already written. When such an
 538        attempt leaves a non-empty task-attributable delta, the artifact is a
 539        candidate -- neither trustworthy nor disposable -- and belongs in review
 540        and verification rather than the bin (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
 541        """
 542        if failure_class != ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED:
 543            return False
 544        return delta is not None and not delta.is_empty
 545
 546    def _capture_timeout_candidate(
 547        self,
 548        run_dir: Path,
 549        attempts_dir: Path,
 550        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 551        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 552        resource_id: str,
 553        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 554    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 555        """Preserves a budget-stopped candidate and marks it as needing governance.
 556
 557        Written before any rollback can run, and deliberately separate from the
 558        provider's own result: `implementation/result.json` keeps success=false,
 559        so nothing here fabricates a completion the provider never claimed.
 560        """
 561        candidate = {
 562            "candidate_captured": True,
 563            "provider_completion_claim": False,
 564            "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
 565            "requires_governance": True,
 566            "failure_class": ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.value,
 567            "resource_id": resource_id,
 568            "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
 569            "files_added": list(delta.files_added),
 570            "files_modified": list(delta.files_modified),
 571            "files_deleted": list(delta.files_deleted),
 572            "insertions": delta.insertions,
 573            "deletions": delta.deletions,
 574            "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 575            "schema": TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 576        }
 577        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{resource_id}"
 578        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 579        atomic_write_json(attempt_dir / "candidate.json", candidate)
 580        (attempt_dir / "candidate.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 581
 582        attempt_record["candidate"] = candidate
 583        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 584
 585        # Publish it as the run's current diff so the existing review and
 586        # verification stages act on it exactly as they would a normal one.
 587        self._write_delta_patch(delta, run_dir / "implementation", run_dir)
 588        self._record_event(
 589            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 590            agent_id=resource_id,
 591            action="timeout_candidate_captured",
 592            spec=task_spec,
 593            metadata={
 594                "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
 595                "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
 596                "provider_completion_claim": False,
 597                "files_changed": len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added),
 598                "insertions": delta.insertions,
 599                "deletions": delta.deletions,
 600            },
 601        )
 602        return candidate
 603
 604    def _build_failover_summary(
 605        self,
 606        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]],
 607        termination_reason: str,
 608        last_decision: Any,
 609    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 610        """Explains exhaustion so an operator never has to guess why it stopped."""
 611        remaining: List[str] = []
 612        excluded: Dict[str, str] = {}
 613        if last_decision is not None:
 614            selected = getattr(last_decision, "selected", None)
 615            remaining = [
 616                identity.resource_id
 617                for identity in getattr(last_decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
 618                if selected is None or identity.resource_id != selected.resource_id
 619            ]
 620            excluded = {
 621                exclusion.resource_id: exclusion.reason
 622                for exclusion in getattr(last_decision, "exclusions", []) or []
 623            }
 624        return {
 625            "attempts_used": len(implementation_attempts),
 626            "attempts_allowed": self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts,
 627            "termination_reason": termination_reason,
 628            "attempted_resources": [
 629                {
 630                    "attempt": attempt.get("attempt"),
 631                    "resource_id": attempt.get("resource_id"),
 632                    "failure_class": attempt.get("failure_class"),
 633                }
 634                for attempt in implementation_attempts
 635            ],
 636            "remaining_eligible": remaining,
 637            "excluded": excluded,
 638            "schema": FAILOVER_SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 639        }
 640
 641    def _is_failover_eligible_failure(self, failure_class: Optional[Any]) -> bool:
 642        """Returns True when the normalized failure class justifies provider failover."""
 643        if failure_class is None:
 644            return False
 645        return failure_class in {
 646            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 647            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
 648            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
 649            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
 650            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
 651            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
 652            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
 653            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 654            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED,
 655        }
 656
 657    def _map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(
 658        self,
 659        failure_class: Optional[Any],
 660    ) -> str:
 661        """Maps a provider failure class to the orchestrator's coarse failure class."""
 662        if failure_class is None:
 663            return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
 664        value = getattr(failure_class, "value", str(failure_class))
 665        if value in {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_LIMIT", "RATE_LIMITED"}:
 666            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED
 667        if value == "EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED":
 668            return FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
 669        if value in {
 670            "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
 671            "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE",
 672            "TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE",
 673            "MISSING_EXECUTABLE",
 674            "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED",
 675        }:
 676            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
 677        return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
 678
 679    def _persist_effective_route(
 680        self,
 681        routing: Any,
 682        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 683        attempt_resource_id: str,
 684        route_status: str,
 685        accepted: bool,
 686    ) -> None:
 687        """Makes routing evidence on disk match who is actually implementing.
 688
 689        This used to run only after a *successful* failover, so a run that
 690        failed over and then failed left route.json still naming the originally
 691        routed provider, with no effective_route.json at all -- durable evidence
 692        contradicting the run (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Routing becomes durable at
 693        every real handoff instead, and distinguishes the resource currently
 694        attempting implementation from one whose work was actually accepted.
 695
 696        initial_route.json is never touched here; it stays the immutable record
 697        of what was routed first.
 698        """
 699        if self.config.provider_pool is None:
 700            return
 701        if "initial_route" not in routing.metadata:
 702            routing.metadata["initial_route"] = {
 703                "selected_agent_id": routing.selected_agent_id,
 704                "selected_agent_name": getattr(
 705                    routing, "selected_agent_name", routing.selected_agent_id
 706                ),
 707                "reviewer_resource_mapping": dict(
 708                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping", {})
 709                ),
 710                "reviewer_resource_identities": dict(
 711                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_identities", {})
 712                ),
 713                "review_diversity_achieved": routing.metadata.get(
 714                    "review_diversity_achieved"
 715                ),
 716            }
 717
 718        # Reviewers are recomputed against whoever is implementing now, so no
 719        # mapping can imply a provider reviews its own work. Until a candidate
 720        # is actually accepted the mapping is labelled provisional, because the
 721        # implementer may change again on the next hop.
 722        mapping, diversity = self.config.provider_pool.select_reviewers(
 723            attempt_resource_id,
 724            routing.recommended_reviewers,
 725            task=task_spec,
 726        )
 727        registry = self.config.provider_pool.registry
 728        identities = {
 729            role: registry.get_resource(resource_id).resource_identity().to_dict()
 730            for role, resource_id in mapping.items()
 731            if registry.get_resource(resource_id) is not None
 732        }
 733        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_mapping"] = mapping
 734        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_identities"] = identities
 735        routing.metadata["review_diversity_achieved"] = diversity
 736        routing.metadata["reviewer_mapping_status"] = (
 737            "CONFIRMED" if accepted else "PROVISIONAL"
 738        )
 739        routing.metadata["route_status"] = route_status
 740        routing.metadata["current_attempt_resource"] = attempt_resource_id
 741        routing.metadata["last_attempted_implementation_resource"] = attempt_resource_id
 742        routing.metadata["accepted_implementation_resource"] = (
 743            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
 744        )
 745        routing.metadata["final_implementation_resource"] = (
 746            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
 747        )
 748        routing.metadata["final_route"] = {
 749            "selected_agent_id": attempt_resource_id,
 750            "accepted": accepted,
 751            "reviewer_resource_mapping": mapping,
 752            "reviewer_resource_identities": identities,
 753            "review_diversity_achieved": diversity,
 754        }
 755        routing.metadata["reassignment_reason"] = (
 756            f"Implementation moved from {routing.selected_agent_id} to "
 757            f"{attempt_resource_id}; reviewers recomputed to keep review "
 758            f"independent of the implementer"
 759        )
 760
 761        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 762        if run_dir.exists():
 763            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
 764            effective = asdict(routing)
 765            effective["selected_agent_id"] = attempt_resource_id
 766            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "effective_route.json", effective)
 767
 768        self._record_event(
 769            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 770            agent_id="control_plane",
 771            action="effective_route_updated",
 772            spec=task_spec,
 773            metadata={
 774                "initial_implementation_resource": routing.selected_agent_id,
 775                "attempt_resource": attempt_resource_id,
 776                "accepted_implementation_resource": (
 777                    attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
 778                ),
 779                "route_status": route_status,
 780                "reviewer_mapping": mapping,
 781                "diversity_achieved": diversity,
 782            },
 783        )
 784
 785    def _record_event(
 786        self,
 787        task_id: str,
 788        agent_id: str,
 789        action: str,
 790        command: Optional[str] = None,
 791        result: Optional[str] = None,
 792        artifact: Optional[str] = None,
 793        spec: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
 794        findings_summary: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
 795        verification_summary: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 796        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
 797    ) -> None:
 798        """Records an immutable event in the append-only evidence ledger."""
 799        if not self.config.record_evidence:
 800            return
 801
 802        meta = metadata or {}
 803        entry = EvidenceEntry(
 804            task_id=task_id,
 805            agent_id=agent_id,
 806            action=action,
 807            command=command,
 808            result=result,
 809            artifact=artifact,
 810            task_class=spec.task_class if spec else None,
 811            risk_level=spec.risk_level if spec else None,
 812            reasoning_tier=spec.recommended_reasoning_tier if spec else None,
 813            actual_agent=agent_id,
 814            repository=self.target_repo.name,
 815            findings_summary=findings_summary,
 816            verification_summary=verification_summary,
 817            metadata=meta,
 818        )
 819        try:
 820            self.ledger.append_entry(entry)
 821        except Exception:
 822            pass
 823

 831        (stage_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 832        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
