 848    def prepare_task_plan(
 849        self,
 850        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 851        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 852    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
 853        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
 854        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 855        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 856        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 857        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 858
 859        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
 860        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 861
 862        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
 863        routing = router.route(task_spec)
 864        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
 865        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
 866
 867        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
 868        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 869
 870        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
 871        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
 872        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
 873        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
 874        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
 875            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
 876        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 877        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
 878        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
 879            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 880            if role:
 881                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
 882                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
 883                )
 884        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
 885
 886        hf_res = None
 887        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
 888            try:
 889                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
 890                    context=ctx,
 891                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
 892                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 893                    ledger=self.ledger,
 894                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
 895                )
 896                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
 897            except Exception:
 898                pass
 899
 900        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
 901        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
 902            task=task_spec,
 903            planned_actions=planned_actions,
 904            target_repo=self.target_repo,
 905        )
 906        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
 907        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
 908            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 909
 910        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res
 911
 912    def _bind_decision_packet(self, boundary_res: Any, run_dir: Path) -> None:
 913        """Binds bounded executor decision ID to human decision packet if required."""
 914        if not boundary_res.requires_human_approval or not boundary_res.decision_packet:
 915            return
 916        if not boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions:
 917            return
 918        act_dict = boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions[0]
 919        action_obj = ProposedAction.from_dict(act_dict)
 920        from src.control_plane.executor import ExecutorRegistry
 921        executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action_obj.action_type)
 922        if executor and executor.is_available():
 923            verdict, dec_id, _ = executor.evaluate(action_obj, self.target_repo, run_dir)
 924            if dec_id:
 925                boundary_res.decision_packet.changeops_decision_id = dec_id
 926                boundary_res.decision_packet.executor_id = executor.name
 927
 928    def run(
 929        self,
 930        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 931        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 932    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
 933        """
 934        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
 935        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
 936        """
 937        start_time = time.time()
 938        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 939
 940        # Setup Progress Tracker
 941        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
 942        if progress is None:
 943            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
 944            stream = (
 945                self.config.progress_stream
 946                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
 947                else sys.stderr
 948            )
 949            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
 950                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 951                run_dir=run_dir,
 952                stream=stream,
 953                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
 954                enabled=enabled,
 955            )
 956
 957        progress.start(
 958            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 959            run_dir=run_dir,
 960            initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
 961        )
 962
 963        # Acquire Locks if enabled
 964        repo_lock = (
 965            RepoLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute")
 966            if self.config.acquire_locks
 967            else None
 968        )
 969        task_lock = (
 970            TaskLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate")
 971            if self.config.acquire_locks
 972            else None
 973        )
 974
 975        if repo_lock:
 976            repo_lock.acquire()
 977        if task_lock:
 978            task_lock.acquire()
 979
 980        try:
 981            result = self._run_governed_loop(
 982                task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
 983            )
 984            if self.trajectory_store is not None:
 985                traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
 986                self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
 987                result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
 988            return result
 989        except Exception as exc:
 990            progress.record_terminal(
 991                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
 992                TaskPhase.FAILED,
 993                error_message=str(exc),
 994            )
 995            if run_dir.is_dir():
 996                try:
 997                    CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
 998                        run_dir,
 999                        stage=task_spec.current_state,
1000                        reason=str(exc),
1001                        result_summary={"error": str(exc), "interrupted": True},
1002                    )
1003                except Exception:
1004                    pass
1005            raise
1006        finally:
1007            progress.close()
1008            if task_lock:
1009                task_lock.release()
1010            if repo_lock:
1011                repo_lock.release()
1012
1013    def _run_governed_loop(
1014        self,
1015        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1016        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1017        start_time: Optional[float] = None,
1018        progress: Optional[TaskProgressTracker] = None,
1019    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
1020        start_time = start_time or time.time()
1021        if progress is None:
1022            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
1023                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1024                run_dir=None,
1025                enabled=False,
1026            )
1027
1028        progress.transition(
1029            TaskPhase.ROUTING, details="selecting implementation resource"
1030        )
1031        ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res = self.prepare_task_plan(task_spec, planned_actions)
1032        reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
1033        remediation_base_dir = run_dir / "remediation"
1034        hf_audit_status = hf_res.status if hf_res else None
1035        hf_audit_match = (hf_res.status == "MATCH") if hf_res else True
1036
1037        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1038            run_dir,
1039            task_spec.task_id,
1040            "planned",
1041            repo_path=self.target_repo,
1042            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "route.json"), str(run_dir / "verification_plan.json")],
1043        )
1044
1045        self._record_event(
1046            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1047            agent_id="control_plane",
1048            action="task_created",
1049            spec=task_spec,
1050            metadata={"repo_path": str(self.target_repo), "project_types": ctx.project_types},
1051        )
1052        self._record_event(
1053            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1054            agent_id="control_plane",
1055            action="project_discovered",
1056            spec=task_spec,
1057            metadata={"hygiene_status": ctx.hygiene_status, "has_agents_md": ctx.has_agents_md},
1058        )
1059        self._record_event(
1060            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1061            agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
1062            action="route_selected",
1063            spec=task_spec,
1064            metadata={
1065                "selected_agent": routing.selected_agent_id,
1066                "reviewers": routing.recommended_reviewers,
1067                "is_override": routing.is_override,
1068            },
1069        )
1070        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "planned")
1071
1072        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1073        # Stage 2.5: Pre-Execution Human Authority Gating
1074        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1075        pre_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
1076            task=task_spec,
1077            planned_actions=planned_actions,
1078            target_repo=self.target_repo,
1079        )
1080        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_boundary, run_dir)
1081
1082        if pre_boundary.requires_human_approval:
1083            progress.record_terminal(
1084                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
1085                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
1086            )
1087            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1088                run_dir,
1089                task_spec.task_id,
1090                "awaiting_human",
1091                repo_path=self.target_repo,
1092                metadata={"boundary_triggers": pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries},
1093            )
1094            task_spec.transition_to(
1095                "awaiting_human",
1096                f"Pre-execution human authority boundary triggered: {pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries}",
1097            )
1098            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1099
1100            if pre_boundary.decision_packet:
1101                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
1102                    pre_boundary.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
1103                )
1104
1105            self._record_human_boundary_events(
1106                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries, reason="Pre-execution boundary triggered"
1107            )
1108
1109            stage_kwargs = dict(
1110                start_time=start_time,
1111                run_dir=run_dir,
1112                routing=routing,
1113                initial_delta=None,
1114                current_delta=None,
1115                review_cycles=[],
1116                reconciliation=None,
1117                verif_plan=verif_plan,
1118                boundary_res=pre_boundary,
1119                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1120                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1121                remediation_count=0,
1122            )
1123            return self._make_result(task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2, **stage_kwargs)
1124
1125        if not routing.selected_agent_id:
1126            blocked = routing.metadata.get("blocked_outcome") or {
1127                "status": "BLOCKED",
1128                "reason": FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
1129            }
1130            progress.record_terminal(
1131                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
1132                TaskPhase.FAILED,
1133                error_message=blocked.get("reason"),
1134            )
1135            task_spec.transition_to("blocked", blocked["reason"])
1136            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1137            return self._make_result(
1138                task_spec,
1139                "blocked",
1140                3,
1141                start_time=start_time,
1142                run_dir=run_dir,
1143                routing=routing,
1144                verif_plan=verif_plan,
1145                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1146                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1147                err_msg=json.dumps(blocked, sort_keys=True),
1148                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
1149            )
1150
1151        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1152        # Stage 3: Baseline Capture / Baseline Recovery
1153        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1154        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
1155        if baseline_file.is_file():
1156            try:
1157                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
1158            except Exception:
1159                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1160                (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1161        else:
1162            baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1163            (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1164
1165        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1166        # Stage 4: Implementation (implementing) / Reconcile on Recovery
1167        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1168        has_existing_delta, rec_delta, rec_msg = CrashRecoveryEngine.reconcile_interrupted_implementation(
1169            self.target_repo, run_dir, task_spec
1170        )
1171
1172        impl_dir = run_dir / "implementation"
1173        impl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1174        attempts_dir = impl_dir / "attempts"
1175        attempts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1176
1177        # Stays None on the crash-recovery path, where an interrupted
1178        # implementation's delta is reconciled rather than re-run: there is no
1179        # provider execution in *this* process to report (#59.1 Phase 1).
1180        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
1181        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
1182        # Declared out here because a resumed run can skip the attempt loop
1183        # entirely and still needs to report failover accounting.
1184        last_selection_decision: Optional[Any] = None
1185        # Set only when a budget-stopped attempt left a delta worth governing.
1186        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
1187
1188        if has_existing_delta and rec_delta:
1189            current_delta = rec_delta
1190            initial_delta = rec_delta
1191            self._record_event(
1192                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1193                agent_id="control_plane",
1194                action="implementation_recovered",
1195                spec=task_spec,
1196                metadata={"files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)},
1197            )
1198        else:
1199            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1200                run_dir,
1201                task_spec.task_id,
1202                "implementing",
1203                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
1204                repo_path=self.target_repo,
1205            )
1206
1207            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1208                self.config.failure_injection_hook("implementing", run_dir, task_spec)
1209
1210            impl_prompt = self._build_implementation_prompt(task_spec, ctx)
1211            current_impl_resource_id = routing.selected_agent_id
1212            attempted_impl_resource_ids: Set[str] = set()
1213            final_impl_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
1214
1215            def fail_implementation(
1216                err_msg: str,
1217                failure_class: str,
1218                exit_code: int = 1,
1219                termination_reason: str = TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
1220                rollback: bool = True,
1221            ) -> OrchestrationResult:
1222                """Terminal-fails the run from inside the implementation attempt loop.
1223
1224                Reads the attempt-scoped locals (delta, provider execution, attempt
1225                records) at call time, so every terminal path reports the state as of
1226                the attempt that failed.
1227
1228                Rollback used to sit at the end of the failover branch, where it
1229                only ever ran to prepare a clean tree for a *next* attempt. A
1230                terminal attempt therefore left its edits behind and its record
1231                carried no rollback key at all, contaminating the next run's
1232                starting state (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Undoing it here instead
1233                makes every terminal implementation failure restore the
1234                pre-task baseline, and say so. Evidence is already written by
1235                this point, so the patch survives the restore.
1236                """
1237                # Unconditional, exactly like the inter-attempt rollback: a
1238                # task-attributable delta can be empty while the provider has
1239                # still clobbered a file the operator had already modified,
1240                # which capture_delta deliberately excludes. Only the baseline
1241                # restore knows how to put those back.
1242                if current_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
1243                    self._persist_effective_route(
1244                        routing,
1245                        task_spec,
1246                        current_impl_resource_id,
1247                        ROUTE_STATUS_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILED,
1248                        accepted=False,
1249                    )
1250                if rollback:
1251                    restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
1252                        self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
1253                    )
1254                    self._attach_rollback_result(
1255                        attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
1256                    )
1257                    if not restored_ok:
1258                        err_msg = (
1259                            f"{err_msg} Repository could not be restored to baseline "
1260                            f"({restore_err}); task-attributable changes remain."
1261                        )
1262                return self._fail_task(
1263                    task_spec,
1264                    run_dir,
1265                    err_msg,
1266                    start_time,
1267                    exit_code=exit_code,
1268                    agent_id="control_plane",
1269                    progress_tracker=progress,
1270                    routing=routing,
1271                    initial_delta=current_delta,
1272                    current_delta=current_delta,
1273                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
1274                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1275                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1276                    provider_execution=impl_res,
1277                    failure_class=failure_class,
1278                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
1279                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
1280                        implementation_attempts,
1281                        termination_reason,
1282                        last_selection_decision,
1283                    ),
1284                )
1285
1286            def govern_candidate() -> Dict[str, Any]:
1287                """Preserves the current attempt's delta as a governed candidate.
1288
1289                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, the same way
1290                fail_implementation does, so both terminal exits salvage
1291                identically.
1292                """
1293                captured = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
1294                    run_dir=run_dir,
1295                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1296                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
1297                    task_spec=task_spec,
1298                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1299                    delta=current_delta,
1300                )
1301                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
1302                return captured
1303
1304            for attempt_num in range(1, self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts + 1):
1305                impl_res = None
1306                normalized_failure = None
1307
1308                if self.config.custom_backend is not None:
1309                    impl_backend = self.config.custom_backend
1310                elif self.config.backend_resolver is not None:
1311                    impl_backend = self.config.backend_resolver(current_impl_resource_id)
1312                else:
1313                    impl_backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(current_impl_resource_id)
1314
1315                if not impl_backend.is_available():
1316                    impl_res = AgentExecutionResult(
1317                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1318                        role="implementation",
1319                        command=f"backend:{current_impl_resource_id}",
1320                        exit_code=127,
1321                        stdout="",
1322                        stderr=f"Agent binary '{current_impl_resource_id}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
1323                        duration_seconds=0.0,
1324                        success=False,
1325                        error_message=f"Agent '{current_impl_resource_id}' unavailable",
1326                    )
1327                else:
1328                    if task_spec.current_state != "implementing":
1329                        task_spec.transition_to(
1330                            "implementing",
1331                            f"Launching implementation attempt {attempt_num}: {current_impl_resource_id}",
1332                        )
1333                        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1334
1335                    task_spec.actual_agent = current_impl_resource_id
1336                    task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1337
1338                    self._record_event(
1339                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1340                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1341                        action="implementation_started",
1342                        spec=task_spec,
1343                        metadata={"attempt": attempt_num},
1344                    )
1345
1346                    attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{current_impl_resource_id}"
1347                    (attempt_dir / "workspace").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1348                    evidence_root_before = {
1349                        entry.name for entry in run_dir.iterdir() if entry.is_file()
1350                    }
1351
1352                    impl_agent_id = getattr(impl_backend, "agent_id", None) or current_impl_resource_id
1353                    with progress.operation(
1354                        phase=TaskPhase.IMPLEMENTING,
1355                        resource_id=impl_agent_id,
1356                        role="implementation",
1357                        details="started",
1358                        suppress_completion=True,
1359                    ):
1360                        impl_res = impl_backend.execute(
1361                            task=task_spec,
1362                            cwd=self.target_repo,
1363                            role="implementation",
1364                            prompt_override=impl_prompt,
1365                            timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
1366                        )
1367
1368                # Relocate provider scratch before any evidence for this
1369                # attempt is written, so control-plane artifacts can never be
1370                # mistaken for files the provider left behind.
1371                if impl_backend.is_available():
1372                    swept = self._sweep_provider_scratch(
1373                        run_dir=run_dir,
1374                        attempt_dir=attempts_dir
1375                        / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{current_impl_resource_id}",
1376                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1377                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
1378                        known_before=evidence_root_before,
1379                    )
1380                    if swept:
1381                        self._record_event(
1382                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1383                            agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1384                            action="provider_scratch_relocated",
1385                            spec=task_spec,
1386                            metadata={"attempt": attempt_num, "files": swept},
1387                        )
1388
1389                # Snapshot capacity before record_result mutates it, so the
1390                # recorded "before" is genuinely the pre-attempt state.
1391                capacity_before: Dict[str, str] = (
1392                    self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
1393                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
1394                )
1395
1396                if self.config.provider_pool is not None and impl_res is not None:
1397                    normalized_failure = self.config.provider_pool.record_result(
1398                        current_impl_resource_id,
1399                        impl_res,
1400                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1401                    )
1402
1403                current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
1404                    task_spec, baseline, current_impl_resource_id, stage="implementation"
1405                )
1406
1407                denial_outcome = (
1408                    (impl_res.metadata or {}).get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY)
1409                    if impl_res is not None else None
1410                )
1411                if (
1412                    impl_res is not None
1413                    and impl_res.success
1414                    and denial_outcome == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED
1415                    and current_delta.is_empty
1416                ):
1417                    impl_res.success = False
1418                    if not impl_res.error_message:
1419                        impl_res.error_message = (
1420                            "Required tool permissions were unavailable and zero delta produced"
1421                        )
1422                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
1423                        normalized_failure = ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
1424
1425                attempt_record = self._record_implementation_attempt(
1426                    run_dir=run_dir,
1427                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1428                    attempt_num=attempt_num,
1429                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1430                    impl_res=impl_res,
1431                    delta=current_delta,
1432                    failure_class=normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None,
1433                    capacity_before=capacity_before,
1434                )
1435                implementation_attempts.append(attempt_record)
1436
1437                if impl_res is not None and impl_res.success:
1438                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
1439                    (impl_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1440                    self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, impl_dir, run_dir)
1441                    self._record_event(
1442                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1443                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1444                        action="implementation_completed",
1445                        result="success",
1446                        spec=task_spec,
1447                        metadata={
1448                            "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
1449                            "attempt": attempt_num,
1450                        },
1451                    )
1452                    self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
1453                    break
1454
1455                # Failed attempt: determine whether to failover or terminal-fail.
1456                err_msg = (
1457                    impl_res.stderr.strip()
1458                    if impl_res and impl_res.stderr and impl_res.stderr.strip()
1459                    else (impl_res.error_message if impl_res else f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id}")
1460                )
1461                failure_class_value = normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None
1462
1463                progress.emit_implementation_failed(
1464                    current_impl_resource_id,
1465                    reason=failure_class_value or err_msg,
1466                )
1467
1468                # This resource is spent for this task from here on, whatever
1469                # happens next. Recording it before selection is what stops a
1470                # resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt from being offered
1471                # back and dead-ending the loop (SLOPFIX-03).
1472                attempted_impl_resource_ids.add(current_impl_resource_id)
1473
1474                if not self._is_failover_eligible_failure(normalized_failure):
1475                    return fail_implementation(
1476                        err_msg,
1477                        self._map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(normalized_failure),
1478                        exit_code=impl_res.exit_code if impl_res and impl_res.exit_code != 0 else 1,
1479                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
1480                    )
1481
1482                # No further provider can be tried, but this attempt may still
1483                # have left something worth governing. Salvage is checked only
1484                # here, at the end of the chain: while failover budget remains a
1485                # fresh provider may yet produce a complete, provider-attested
1486                # result, and that is strictly better than governing a fragment.
1487                salvageable = self._is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
1488                    normalized_failure, current_delta
1489                )
1490                exhausted = attempt_num >= self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts
1491
1492                if exhausted and salvageable:
1493                    timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
1494                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
1495                    break
1496
1497                if exhausted:
1498                    err_msg = (
1499                        f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}); "
1500                        f"max failover attempts ({self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts}) reached."
1501                    )
1502                    return fail_implementation(
1503                        err_msg,
1504                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
1505                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS_REACHED,
1506                    )
1507
1508                # Select next eligible implementation resource. Everything already
1509                # attempted is a hard exclusion, not merely a demotion.
1510                next_resource_id = None
1511                if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
1512                    next_decision = self.config.provider_pool.select_resource(
1513                        task_spec,
1514                        role="implementation",
1515                        avoid_resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
1516                        exclude_resource_ids=attempted_impl_resource_ids,
1517                    )
1518                    last_selection_decision = next_decision
1519                    self._attach_next_selection(attempt_record, attempts_dir, next_decision)
1520                    if next_decision.selected:
1521                        next_resource_id = next_decision.selected.resource_id
1522
1523                if (
1524                    not next_resource_id
1525                    or next_resource_id == current_impl_resource_id
1526                    or next_resource_id in attempted_impl_resource_ids
1527                ):
1528                    if salvageable:
1529                        timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
1530                        final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
1531                        break
1532
1533                    err_msg = f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}) and no eligible failover resource remains."
1534                    return fail_implementation(
1535                        err_msg,
1536                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
1537                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
1538                    )
1539
1540                # Restore repository to baseline before the next attempt.
1541                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
1542                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
1543                )
1544                self._attach_rollback_result(
1545                    attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
1546                )
1547                if not restored_ok:
1548                    err_msg = f"Implementation failover aborted: cannot safely restore baseline ({restore_err})."
1549                    return fail_implementation(
1550                        err_msg,
1551                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1552                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_ROLLBACK_FAILED,
1553                        rollback=False,
1554                    )
1555
1556                progress.emit_failover(
1557                    current_impl_resource_id,
1558                    next_resource_id,
1559                    failure_class=failure_class_value,
1560                )
1561                self._record_event(
1562                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1563                    agent_id="control_plane",
1564                    action="implementation_failover",
1565                    spec=task_spec,
1566                    metadata={
1567                        "attempt": attempt_num,
1568                        "source_resource": current_impl_resource_id,
1569                        "target_resource": next_resource_id,
1570                        "failure_class": failure_class_value,
1571                    },
1572                )
1573
1574                current_impl_resource_id = next_resource_id
1575                self._persist_effective_route(
1576                    routing,
1577                    task_spec,
1578                    current_impl_resource_id,
1579                    ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
1580                    accepted=False,
1581                )
1582
1583            if timeout_candidate is None and (impl_res is None or not impl_res.success):
1584                err_msg = (
1585                    f"Implementation exhausted all {self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts} "
1586                    "attempted provider(s) without success."
1587                )
1588                return self._fail_task(
1589                    task_spec,
1590                    run_dir,
1591                    err_msg,
1592                    start_time,
1593                    exit_code=1,
1594                    agent_id="control_plane",
1595                    progress_tracker=progress,
1596                    routing=routing,
1597                    current_delta=current_delta if "current_delta" in locals() else None,
1598                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
1599                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1600                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1601                    provider_execution=impl_res,
1602                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
1603                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
1604                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
1605                        implementation_attempts,
1606                        TERMINATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED,
1607                        last_selection_decision,
1608                    ),
1609                )
1610
1611            initial_delta = current_delta
1612            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1613                run_dir,
1614                "implementing",
1615                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
1616            )
1617
1618            # If the final implementation resource differs from the initially
1619            # routed one, recompute reviewer assignments so independence claims
1620            # are truthful (#59.2 Phase 9).
1621            if (
1622                final_impl_resource_id is not None
1623                and final_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id
1624                and self.config.provider_pool is not None
1625            ):
1626                self._persist_effective_route(
1627                    routing,
1628                    task_spec,
1629                    final_impl_resource_id,
1630                    ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
1631                    accepted=True,
1632                )
1633
1634            # A salvaged candidate carries no completion claim from its
1635            # producer, so independent review is the only thing standing behind
1636            # it. When no independent reviewer is available the pool falls back
1637            # to the implementer reviewing its own work, which for this kind of
1638            # candidate is no review at all. Park it for a human rather than
1639            # completing on a self-review (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
1640            if timeout_candidate is not None and not routing.metadata.get(
1641                "review_diversity_achieved", True
1642            ):
1643                err_msg = (
1644                    "Timed-out implementation candidate cannot be independently "
1645                    f"reviewed: no reviewer is available other than "
1646                    f"{final_impl_resource_id}, which produced it."
1647                )
1648                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
1649                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1650                    objective=task_spec.objective,
1651                    change_summary=(
1652                        f"Candidate ({current_delta.insertions} ins, "
1653                        f"{current_delta.deletions} del) was left by "
1654                        f"{final_impl_resource_id} after this control plane "
1655                        "stopped it at its execution budget. The provider never "
1656                        "reported completion."
1657                    ),
1658                    boundary_triggers=["reviewer_independence_unavailable"],
1659                    evidence=[
1660                        f"origin={CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT}",
1661                        "provider_completion_claim=false",
1662                    ],
1663                    risks=[
1664                        "No independent reviewer is available, so the candidate "
1665                        "has nothing standing behind it.",
1666                    ],
1667                    review_findings_summary={
1668                        "blocker": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0,
1669                    },
1670                    verification_status="unverified",
1671                    recommended_action=(
1672                        "Inspect implementation/attempts/*/candidate.patch and "
1673                        "either authorize it explicitly or discard it."
1674                    ),
1675                )
1676                self._park_awaiting_human(
1677                    task_spec, run_dir, err_msg, decision_pkt, progress
1678                )
1679                return self._make_result(
1680                    task_spec=task_spec,
1681                    final_state="awaiting_human",
1682                    exit_code=2,
1683                    start_time=start_time,
1684                    run_dir=run_dir,
1685                    routing=routing,
1686                    initial_delta=initial_delta,
1687                    current_delta=current_delta,
1688                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
1689                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1690                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1691                    provider_execution=impl_res,
1692                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
1693                    timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
1694                )
1695
1696            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1697                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_implementation", run_dir, task_spec)
1698
1699        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1700        # Stage 5: Independent Adversarial Reviews & Remediation Loop
1701        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1702        if task_spec.current_state != "reviewing":
1703            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", "Initiating independent reviewer analysis on actual implementation diff")
1704            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1705
1706        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = []
1707        latest_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
1708        remediation_count = 0
1709        current_reviewers = list(routing.recommended_reviewers)
1710
1711        while True:
1712            cycle_idx = len(review_cycles) + 1
1713            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1714                run_dir,
1715                task_spec.task_id,
1716                "reviewing",
1717                repo_path=self.target_repo,
1718                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
1719            )
1720
1721            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1722                self.config.failure_injection_hook("reviewing", run_dir, task_spec)
1723
1724            self._record_event(
1725                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1726                agent_id="control_plane",
1727                action="review_started",
1728                spec=task_spec,
1729                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
1730            )
1731
1732            cycle_res = ReviewRunner.execute_review_cycle(
1733                task=task_spec,
1734                diff_content=current_delta.diff_content,
1735                reviewer_roles=current_reviewers,
1736                cwd=self.target_repo,
1737                backend=self.config.custom_backend,
1738                cycle_index=cycle_idx,
1739                reviewer_agent_mapping=(
1740                    self.config.reviewer_agent_mapping
1741                    or routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping")
1742                ),
1743                custom_reviewer_fn=self.config.custom_reviewer_fn,
1744                run_dir=run_dir,
1745                provider_pool=self.config.provider_pool,
1746                progress_tracker=progress,
1747            )
1748            review_cycles.append(cycle_res)
1749            latest_reconciliation = cycle_res.reconciliation
1750
1751            # Save review cycle artifacts
1752            cycle_dir = reviews_dir if cycle_idx == 1 else (remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}" / "re_review")
1753            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1754            for role_id, single_rev in cycle_res.reviewer_results.items():
1755                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(single_rev.raw_output, encoding="utf-8")
1756                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml").write_text(
1757                    yaml.dump([f.to_dict() for f in single_rev.findings], sort_keys=False),
1758                    encoding="utf-8",
1759                )
1760
1761            # Persist findings and reconciliation
1762            findings_data = {"findings": [f.to_dict() for f in cycle_res.all_findings]}
1763            (run_dir / "findings.yaml").write_text(yaml.dump(findings_data, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
1764            if cycle_res.reconciliation:
1765                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(json.dumps(cycle_res.reconciliation.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
1766                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(cycle_res.reconciliation.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
1767
1768            findings_summary = {
1769                "total": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
1770                "blocker": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
1771                "high": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_highs if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
1772            }
1773            self._record_event(
1774                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1775                agent_id="control_plane",
1776                action="review_completed",
1777                spec=task_spec,
1778                findings_summary=findings_summary,
1779                metadata={"status": cycle_res.status, "cycle": cycle_idx},
1780            )
1781            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1782                run_dir,
1783                "reviewing",
1784                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "reconciliation.json")],
1785                result_summary=findings_summary,
1786            )
1787
1788            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1789                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_review", run_dir, task_spec)
1790
1791            # Check if any findings require remediation
1792            if not cycle_res.requires_remediation:
1793                break
1794
1795            # If remediation required, check cycle bounds
1796            if remediation_count >= self.config.max_remediation_cycles:
1797                err_msg = (
1798                    f"Remediation limit reached ({self.config.max_remediation_cycles} cycles) with "
1799                    f"{findings_summary['blocker']} blockers and {findings_summary['high']} high findings remaining."
1800                )
1801                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
1802                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1803                    objective=task_spec.objective,
1804                    change_summary=f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) has unresolved reviewer findings.",
1805                    boundary_triggers=["security_policy_exception"] if findings_summary["high"] > 0 else ["unresolved_findings"],
1806                    evidence=[f.title for f in cycle_res.all_findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high")],
1807                    risks=["Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities."],
1808                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
1809                    verification_status="unverified",
1810                    recommended_action="Review finding report in reconciliation_report.md and authorize override or manual remediation.",
1811                )
1812                self._park_awaiting_human(
1813                    task_spec,
1814                    run_dir,
1815                    f"Max remediation cycles exceeded: {err_msg}",
1816                    decision_pkt,
1817                    progress,
1818                )
1819                return self._make_result(
1820                    task_spec=task_spec,
1821                    final_state="awaiting_human",
1822                    exit_code=2,
1823                    start_time=start_time,
1824                    run_dir=run_dir,
1825                    routing=routing,
1826                    initial_delta=initial_delta,
1827                    current_delta=current_delta,
1828                    review_cycles=review_cycles,
1829                    reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
1830                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
1831                    remediation_count=remediation_count,
1832                    err_msg=err_msg,
1833                    provider_execution=impl_res,
1834                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
1835                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
1836                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
1837                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
1838                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
1839                        implementation_attempts,
1840                        TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED,
1841                        last_selection_decision,
1842                    ),
1843                )
1844
1845            remediation_count += 1
1846            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1847                run_dir,
1848                task_spec.task_id,
1849                "remediating",
1850                repo_path=self.target_repo,
1851                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count},
1852            )
1853
1854            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1855                self.config.failure_injection_hook("remediating", run_dir, task_spec)
1856
1857            task_spec.transition_to(
1858                "remediating",
1859                f"Remediation cycle {remediation_count}: resolving {len(cycle_res.all_findings)} review findings",
1860            )
1861            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1862
1863            self._record_event(
1864                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1865                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
1866                action="remediation_started",
1867                spec=task_spec,
1868                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings)},
1869            )
1870
1871            rem_cycle_dir = remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}"
1872            rem_cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1873
1874            rem_agent_id = getattr(impl_backend, "agent_id", None) or routing.selected_agent_id
1875            with progress.operation(
1876                phase=TaskPhase.REMEDIATING,
1877                resource_id=rem_agent_id,
1878                role="remediation",
1879                cycle=remediation_count,
1880                details=f"cycle {remediation_count}",
1881            ):
1882                if self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
1883                    self.config.custom_remediation_fn(task_spec, self.target_repo, cycle_res.all_findings)
1884                else:
1885                    rem_prompt = self._build_remediation_prompt(task_spec, current_delta.diff_content, cycle_res.all_findings)
1886                    rem_res = impl_backend.execute(
1887                        task=task_spec,
1888                        cwd=self.target_repo,
1889                        role="remediation",
1890                        prompt_override=rem_prompt,
1891                        timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
1892                    )
1893                    (rem_cycle_dir / "result.json").write_text(rem_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1894
1895            current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
1896                task_spec, baseline, routing.selected_agent_id, stage="remediation"
1897            )
1898            self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, rem_cycle_dir, run_dir)
1899
1900            self._record_event(
1901                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1902                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
1903                action="remediation_completed",
1904                spec=task_spec,
1905                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "files_modified": len(current_delta.files_modified)},
1906            )
1907            self._record_delta_captured(task_spec)
1908            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1909                run_dir,
1910                "remediating",
1911                output_artifacts=[str(rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch")],
1912            )
1913
1914            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1915                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_remediation", run_dir, task_spec)
1916
1917            current_reviewers = ReviewRunner.determine_re_review_roles(
1918                cycle_res.all_findings,
1919                routing.recommended_reviewers,
1920            )
1921            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", f"Re-review cycle {remediation_count + 1} for targeted roles: {current_reviewers}")
1922            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1923
1924        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1925        # Stage 6: Deterministic Verification Gate (verifying)
1926        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1927        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1928            run_dir,
1929            task_spec.task_id,
1930            "verifying",
1931            repo_path=self.target_repo,
1932            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
1933        )
1934
1935        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
1936            self.config.failure_injection_hook("verifying", run_dir, task_spec)
1937
1938        task_spec.transition_to("verifying", "Executing deterministic verification plan")
1939        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1940
1941        self._record_event(
1942            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1943            agent_id="control_plane",
1944            action="verification_started",
1945            spec=task_spec,
1946            metadata={"steps_count": len(verif_plan.steps)},
1947        )
1948
1949        verif_status = verif_plan.execute_all(
1950            cwd=str(self.target_repo),
1951            stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
1952            progress_tracker=progress,
1953        )
1954        (run_dir / "verification_result.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1955
1956        verif_summary = {s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps}
1957        self._record_event(
1958            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1959            agent_id="control_plane",
1960            action="verification_completed",
1961            spec=task_spec,
1962            result=verif_status,
1963            verification_summary=verif_summary,
1964        )
1965        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1966            run_dir,
1967            "verifying",
1968            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "verification_result.json")],
1969            result_summary=verif_summary,
1970        )
1971
1972        if verif_status != "passed":
1973            failed_steps = [s.name for s in verif_plan.steps if s.status == "failed" and s.required]
1974            err_msg = f"Deterministic verification failed on required steps: {', '.join(failed_steps)}"
1975            # A salvaged candidate only ever existed on sufferance. Governance
1976            # has now rejected it, so the repository goes back to its pre-task
1977            # baseline rather than keeping a patch nothing stands behind. A
1978            # provider-attested implementation still keeps its diff in place for
1979            # inspection, as before.
1980            if timeout_candidate is not None and not current_delta.is_empty:
1981                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
1982                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
1983                )
1984                self._record_event(
1985                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1986                    agent_id="control_plane",
1987                    action="timeout_candidate_rejected",
1988                    spec=task_spec,
1989                    metadata={
1990                        "stage": "verifying",
1991                        "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1992                        "rollback_restored": restored_ok,
1993                        "rollback_error": restore_err,
1994                        "failed_steps": failed_steps,
1995                    },
1996                )
1997                if not restored_ok:
1998                    err_msg = (
1999                        f"{err_msg}. Repository could not be restored to baseline "
2000                        f"({restore_err}); candidate changes remain."
2001                    )
2002            return self._fail_task(
2003                task_spec,
2004                run_dir,
2005                err_msg,
2006                start_time,
2007                exit_code=1,
2008                progress_tracker=progress,
2009                routing=routing,
2010                initial_delta=initial_delta,
2011                current_delta=current_delta,
2012                review_cycles=review_cycles,
2013                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
2014                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2015                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2016                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2017                remediation_count=remediation_count,
2018                provider_execution=impl_res,
2019                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_VERIFICATION,
2020                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
2021            )
2022
2023        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2024        # Stage 7: Human Authority Boundary Gate (awaiting_human)
2025        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2026        actions_to_check = list(planned_actions or [])
2027        if any(kw in task_spec.objective.lower() for kw in ["deploy", "terraform apply", "kubectl apply", "drop table"]):
2028            actions_to_check.append(task_spec.objective)
2029
2030        boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(
2031            task=task_spec,
2032            planned_actions=actions_to_check,
2033            change_summary=f"Changed {len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)} files (+{current_delta.insertions}/-{current_delta.deletions})",
2034            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
2035            verification=verif_plan,
2036        )
2037
2038        stage_kwargs = dict(
2039            start_time=start_time,
2040            run_dir=run_dir,
2041            routing=routing,
2042            initial_delta=initial_delta,
2043            current_delta=current_delta,
2044            review_cycles=review_cycles,
2045            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
2046            verif_plan=verif_plan,
2047            boundary_res=boundary_res,
2048            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2049            hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2050            remediation_count=remediation_count,
2051            provider_execution=impl_res,
2052            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2053            failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2054                implementation_attempts,
2055                TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED
2056                if timeout_candidate is None
2057                else TERMINATION_TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_GOVERNED,
2058                last_selection_decision,
2059            ),
2060            timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
2061        )
2062
2063        if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
2064            progress.record_terminal(
2065                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2066                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2067            )
2068            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2069                run_dir,
2070                task_spec.task_id,
2071                "awaiting_human",
2072                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2073                metadata={"boundary_triggers": boundary_res.triggered_boundaries},
2074            )
2075            task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Human authority boundary triggered: {boundary_res.triggered_boundaries}")
2076            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2077
2078            if boundary_res.decision_packet:
2079                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
2080
2081            self._record_human_boundary_events(
2082                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=boundary_res.triggered_boundaries
2083            )
2084
2085            return self._make_result(
2086                task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2,
2087                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, **stage_kwargs,
2088            )
2089
2090        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2091        # Stage 8: Governed Completion (complete)
2092        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2093        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2094            run_dir,
2095            task_spec.task_id,
2096            "complete",
2097            repo_path=self.target_repo,
2098        )
2099        task_spec.transition_to("complete", "All reviews, reconciliations, deterministic verifications, and policies passed.")
2100        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2101
2102        # Generate summary markdown
2103        summary_md = self._render_summary_markdown(
2104            task=task_spec,
2105            routing=routing,
2106            delta=current_delta,
2107            review_cycles=review_cycles,
2108            verif_plan=verif_plan,
2109            remediation_count=remediation_count,
2110            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2111        )
2112        (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(summary_md, encoding="utf-8")
2113
2114        self._record_event(
2115            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2116            agent_id="control_plane",
2117            action="task_completed",
2118            spec=task_spec,
2119            metadata={
2120                "remediation_cycles": remediation_count,
2121                "verification_status": verif_status,
2122                "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2123            },
2124        )
2125        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
2126            run_dir,
2127            "complete",
2128            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "summary.md")],
2129        )
2130
2131        progress.record_terminal(
2132            TaskProgressState.COMPLETE,
2133            TaskPhase.COMPLETE,
2134        )
2135        return self._make_result(task_spec, "complete", 0, **stage_kwargs)
2136
2137    def _record_human_boundary_events(
2138        self,
2139        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2140        run_dir: Path,
2141        boundaries: Optional[List[str]] = None,

2145        self._record_event(

2154            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2155            agent_id="control_plane",
2156            action="human_boundary_triggered",
2157            spec=task_spec,
2158            metadata=meta,
2159        )

2161    def _make_result(
2162        self,
2163        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2164        final_state: str,
2165        exit_code: int,
2166        start_time: float,
2167        run_dir: Path,
2168        routing: Optional[Any] = None,
2169        initial_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
2170        current_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
2171        review_cycles: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
2172        reconciliation: Optional[Any] = None,
2173        verif_plan: Optional[Any] = None,
2174        boundary_res: Optional[Any] = None,
2175        hf_status: Optional[str] = None,
2176        hf_match: Optional[bool] = None,
2177        remediation_count: int = 0,
2178        err_msg: Optional[str] = None,
2179        provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None,
2180        failure_class: Optional[str] = None,
2181        implementation_attempts: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
2182        failover_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
2183        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
2184    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2185        return OrchestrationResult(
2186            implementation_completion_claim=timeout_candidate is None,
2187            candidate_origin=(
2188                timeout_candidate.get("origin") if timeout_candidate else None
2189            ),
2190            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2191            task_spec=task_spec,
2192            final_state=final_state,
2193            exit_code=exit_code,
2194            routing_decision=routing,
2195            initial_delta=initial_delta,
2196            final_delta=current_delta,
2197            review_cycles=review_cycles or [],
2198            reconciliation=reconciliation,
2199            verification_plan=verif_plan,
2200            boundary_result=boundary_res,
2201            howlframe_audit_status=hf_status,
2202            howlframe_audit_match=hf_match,
2203            remediation_cycles_count=remediation_count,
2204            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
2205            error_message=err_msg,
2206            run_dir=str(run_dir),
2207            provider_execution=provider_execution,
2208            failure_class=failure_class,
2209            resource_selection=(
2210                routing.metadata.get("resource_selection")
2211                if routing is not None else None
2212            ),
2213            capacity_after=(
2214                self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
2215                if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
2216            ),
2217            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts or [],
2218            failover_summary=failover_summary,
2219        )
2220
2221    def _fail_task(
2222        self,
2223        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2224        run_dir: Path,
2225        err_msg: str,
2226        start_time: float,
2227        exit_code: int = 1,
2228        agent_id: str = "control_plane",
2229        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
2230        **kwargs,
2231    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2232        if progress_tracker is not None:
2233            progress_tracker.record_terminal(
2234                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2235                TaskPhase.FAILED,
2236                error_message=err_msg,
2237            )
2238        task_spec.transition_to("failed", err_msg)
2239        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2240
2241        # Terminalize current stage checkpoint so it does not remain permanently in_progress
2242        try:
2243            delta = kwargs.get("current_delta") or kwargs.get("initial_delta")
2244            summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
2245                "error": err_msg,
2246                "exit_code": exit_code,
2247            }
2248            if kwargs.get("failure_class"):
2249                summary["failure_class"] = kwargs.get("failure_class")
2250            if delta is not None:
2251                summary.update(delta.to_event_metadata())
2252                summary["partial_work"] = not delta.is_empty
2253            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
2254                run_dir,
2255                stage=kwargs.get("stage") or task_spec.current_state,
2256                reason=err_msg,
2257                result_summary=summary,
2258            )
2259        except Exception:
2260            pass
2261
2262        self._record_event(
2263            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2264            agent_id=agent_id,
2265            action="task_failed",
2266            result=err_msg,
2267            spec=task_spec,
2268        )
2269        return self._make_result(
2270            task_spec=task_spec,
2271            final_state="failed",
2272            exit_code=exit_code,
2273            start_time=start_time,
2274            run_dir=run_dir,
2275            err_msg=err_msg,
2276            **kwargs,
2277        )
2278
2279    def _build_implementation_prompt(
2280        self,
2281        task: TaskSpec,
2282        ctx: Optional[ProjectContext] = None,
2283    ) -> str:
2284        """Constructs an implementation prompt with criteria and skill guidance."""
2285        lines = [
2286            f"# Task Implementation Request: `{task.task_id}`",
2287            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
2288            "",
2289            "## Acceptance Criteria",
2290        ]
2291        for c in task.acceptance_criteria:
2292            lines.append(f"- {c}")
2293        if task.constraints:
2294            lines.append("")
2295            lines.append("## Constraints")
2296            for c in task.constraints:
2297                lines.append(f"- {c}")
2298        if task.required_skills:
2299            lines.append("")
2300            lines.append("## Required Skills")
2301            for s in task.required_skills:
2302                lines.append(f"- {s}")
2303        lines.append("")
2304        lines.append("## Workspace")
2305        lines.append(
2306            f"- Scratch files belong in `{self._attempt_workspace_hint(task)}`."
2307        )
2308        lines.append(
2309            f"- Everything else under `.task_runs/{task.task_id}/` is "
2310            "control-plane evidence. Do not create or edit files there."
2311        )
2312        if "howlframe-app-development" in (task.required_skills or []):
2313            lines.append("")
2314            lines.append("## HowlFrame Application Guidance")
2315            lines.append("- Build & test commands: `bash scripts/build.sh`, `bash scripts/test.sh`")
2316            lines.append("- Standalone bytecode VM runs under capability gates (`network,database,filesystem`).")
2317            lines.append("- Single root form (`http_server`, `web_app`, `cli_app`, or `module`) per `.howl` file.")
2318            lines.append("- Handle fallible parsing/io using `try_let`.")
2319        return "\n".join(lines)
2320
2321    def _build_remediation_prompt(
2322        self,
2323        task: TaskSpec,
2324        diff_content: str,
2325        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
2326    ) -> str:
2327        """Constructs an actionable remediation prompt with confirmed defect evidence."""
2328        lines = [
2329            f"# Remediation Request for Task `{task.task_id}`",
2330            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
2331            "",
2332            "## Identified Defects to Remediate",
2333        ]
2334        for f in findings:
2335            lines.append(f"### [{f.severity.upper()}] {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
2336            if f.location:
2337                lines.append(f"- **Location:** `{f.location}`")
2338            if f.claim:
2339                lines.append(f"- **Claim:** {f.claim}")
2340            if f.evidence:
2341                lines.append(f"- **Evidence / Failure Case:** {f.evidence}")
2342            if f.suggested_fix:
2343                lines.append(f"- **Suggested Fix:** {f.suggested_fix}")
2344            lines.append("")
2345
2346        lines.extend([
2347            "## Current Implementation Diff",
2348            "```diff",
2349            diff_content,
2350            "```",
2351            "",
2352            "## Instructions",
2353            "Fix the reported defects in the repository. Ensure all edge cases and tests pass.",
2354        ])
2355        return "\n".join(lines)
2356
2357    def _render_summary_markdown(
2358        self,
2359        task: TaskSpec,
2360        routing: RoutingDecision,
2361        delta: RepositoryDelta,
2362        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult],
2363        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
2364        remediation_count: int,
2365        hf_status: Optional[str],
2366    ) -> str:
2367        lines = [
2368            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task.task_id}`",
2369            "",
2370            "## Overview",
2371            f"- **Objective:** {task.objective}",
2372            f"- **Repository:** {self.target_repo.name}",
2373            f"- **Final State:** `{task.current_state.upper()}`",
2374            f"- **Implementing Agent:** {task.actual_agent or routing.selected_agent_id} (`{task.actual_agent or routing.selected_agent_id}`)",
2375            f"- **Reasoning Tier:** {routing.reasoning_tier}",
2376            f"- **HowlFrame Shadow Audit:** {hf_status or 'N/A'}",
2377            "",
2378        ]
2379        if task.actual_agent and task.actual_agent != routing.selected_agent_id:
2380            lines.append(f"- **Initial Route:** {routing.selected_agent_name} (`{routing.selected_agent_id}`)")
2381            lines.append("")
2382        lines.extend([
2383            "## Repository Changes",
2384            f"- **Files Added:** {len(delta.files_added)}",
2385            f"- **Files Modified:** {len(delta.files_modified)}",
2386            f"- **Files Deleted:** {len(delta.files_deleted)}",
2387            f"- **Total Insertions:** +{delta.insertions}",
2388            f"- **Total Deletions:** -{delta.deletions}",
2389            "",
2390            "## Review & Remediation",
2391            f"- **Total Review Cycles:** {len(review_cycles)}",
2392            f"- **Remediation Cycles:** {remediation_count}",
2393        ])
2394        if review_cycles:
2395            last_cycle = review_cycles[-1]
2396            lines.append(f"- **Final Review Status:** `{last_cycle.status}`")
2397            for role, res in sorted(last_cycle.reviewer_results.items()):
2398                lines.append(f"  - `{role}`: {res.status} ({len(res.findings)} findings)")
2399
2400        lines.extend([
2401            "",
2402            "## Deterministic Verification",
2403            f"- **Overall Status:** `{verif_plan.overall_status.upper()}`",
2404        ])
2405        executed_steps = [
2406            s for s in verif_plan.steps
2407            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
2408        ]
2409        if not executed_steps and verif_plan.steps:
2410            lines.append(f"- **Discovered:** {len(verif_plan.steps)} steps (not executed — implementation failed before verification)")
2411        for step in verif_plan.steps:
2412            if step.exit_code is not None or step.status in ("verified", "failed"):
2413                mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
2414                lines.append(f"- [{mark}] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
2415            else:
2416                lines.append(f"- [ ] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status}")
2417
2418        lines.extend([
2419            "",
2420            "---",
2421            "*Verified and sealed by HowlPlane AI Engineering Control Plane.*",
2422        ])
2423        return "\n".join(lines)

Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews, remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
