def prepare_task_plan( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, pathlib.Path, Optional[Any]]: 
848    def prepare_task_plan(
849        self,
850        task_spec: TaskSpec,
851        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
852    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
853        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
854        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
855        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
856        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
857        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
858
859        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
860        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
861
862        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
863        routing = router.route(task_spec)
864        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
865        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
866
867        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
868        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
869
870        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
871        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
872        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
873        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
874        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
875            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
876        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
877        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
878        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
879            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
880            if role:
881                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
882                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
883                )
884        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
885
886        hf_res = None
887        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
888            try:
889                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
890                    context=ctx,
891                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
892                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
893                    ledger=self.ledger,
894                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
895                )
896                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
897            except Exception:
898                pass
899
900        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
901        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
902            task=task_spec,
903            planned_actions=planned_actions,
904            target_repo=self.target_repo,
905        )
906        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
907        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
908            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
909
910        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res

Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs.

def run( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> OrchestrationResult: 
 928    def run(
 929        self,
 930        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 931        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 932    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
 933        """
 934        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
 935        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
 936        """
 937        start_time = time.time()
 938        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 939
 940        # Setup Progress Tracker
 941        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
 942        if progress is None:
 943            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
 944            stream = (
 945                self.config.progress_stream
 946                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
 947                else sys.stderr
 948            )
 949            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
 950                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 951                run_dir=run_dir,
 952                stream=stream,
 953                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
 954                enabled=enabled,
 955            )
 956
 957        progress.start(
 958            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 959            run_dir=run_dir,
 960            initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
 961        )
 962
 963        # Acquire Locks if enabled
 964        repo_lock = (
 965            RepoLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute")
 966            if self.config.acquire_locks
 967            else None
 968        )
 969        task_lock = (
 970            TaskLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate")
 971            if self.config.acquire_locks
 972            else None
 973        )
 974
 975        if repo_lock:
 976            repo_lock.acquire()
 977        if task_lock:
 978            task_lock.acquire()
 979
 980        try:
 981            result = self._run_governed_loop(
 982                task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
 983            )
 984            if self.trajectory_store is not None:
 985                traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
 986                self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
 987                result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
 988            return result
 989        except Exception as exc:
 990            progress.record_terminal(
 991                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
 992                TaskPhase.FAILED,
 993                error_message=str(exc),
 994            )
 995            if run_dir.is_dir():
 996                try:
 997                    CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
 998                        run_dir,
 999                        stage=task_spec.current_state,
1000                        reason=str(exc),
1001                        result_summary={"error": str(exc), "interrupted": True},
1002                    )
1003                except Exception:
1004                    pass
1005            raise
1006        finally:
1007            progress.close()
1008            if task_lock:
1009                task_lock.release()
1010            if repo_lock:
1011                repo_lock.release()

Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.

133    reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
134    # Maximum number of implementation providers to try before giving up.
135    # Each provider/resource is attempted at most once per task.
136    max_provider_failover_attempts: int = 3
137    # Optional resolver that overrides AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend. Useful
138    # in deterministic tests to inject per-resource fake backends.
139    backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None
140    # Enables bounded reviewer failover (#59.2 Phase 4) in the governed review
141    # cycle: a reviewer whose assigned provider fails, times out, or emits
142    # invalid/malformed output gets one alternate-provider attempt instead of
143    # immediately blocking the task. Sharing the caller's pool means review
144    # quota exhaustion updates the same provider state implementation failover
145    # reads (#59.2 Phase 9). Left None (the default) by callers that inject a
146    # custom_backend/custom_reviewer_fn, which keeps deterministic tests on the
147    # prior single-attempt path.
148    provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None
149    heartbeat_interval: float = DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS
150    progress_stream: Optional[Any] = None
151    progress_mode: str = "auto"
152    progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None
